非结构网格格点格式的二维标量方程离散伴随

The discrete adjoint of a two-dimensional scalar equation, on an unstructured node-centred scheme

算例是一张环形（O 型）混合网格：内圈是物面，外圈是远场特征边界，贴壁一层用四边形、外层用三角形。物面是无粘壁面，一个弱边界条件（写在通量内部，h=0）；粘性壁面是另一对页面——二维标量对流扩散方程——的题目。未知量放在网格节点上，控制体是围绕节点的中位对偶体。本页先把对偶控制体是怎么“围”出来的一步步画清楚，再把同一个边循环依次改写成 matrix-free 前向（计算 Av）和 matrix-free 伴随（计算 ATw）。每个循环都可以逐句播放。The test case is an annular (O-type) hybrid mesh: the inner ring is the body surface, the outer ring a far-field characteristic boundary, with quadrilaterals in the layer against the wall and triangles outside it. The body is an inviscid wall, a weak boundary condition (imposed inside the flux, h=0); a viscous wall is the subject of another pair of pages, the two-dimensional scalar advection–diffusion equation. The unknowns live on the mesh nodes, and the control volume is the median dual carved out around each node. This page first draws, step by step, how that dual control volume is built, and then rewrites the same edge loop into matrix-free forward (computing Av) and matrix-free adjoint (computing ATw). Every loop can be played statement by statement.

第 1 节
Section 1

网格：混合网格与对偶控制体的构造

Mesh: a hybrid grid and the construction of dual control volumes

算例网格

The test mesh

算例是一张绕物体的环形 O 型网格，3 圈节点、每圈 8 个，共 24 个节点。贴着物面的一层用四边形（8 个），外面一层用三角形（16 个）——这正是实际 CFD 常用的混合网格：近壁面用规则的四边形层，外场用三角形。物体本身是非对称的：它有弯度，而且相对远场圆心有偏置，所以流场、阻力和形状梯度都不带任何对称性。两圈边界的意义完全不同：

The test case is an annular O-type mesh around a body: 3 rings of nodes, 8 to a ring, 24 nodes in all. The layer against the body uses quadrilaterals (8 of them) and the layer outside it triangles (16) — precisely the hybrid mesh that real CFD uses: regular quadrilateral layers near the wall, triangles in the far field. The body itself is asymmetric: it has camber and is offset from the centre of the far-field circle, so the flow, the drag and the shape gradient carry no symmetry whatever. The two rings of boundary mean quite different things:

  • 内圈（8 条边）：无粘壁面，也就是物面；
  • Inner ring (8 edges): inviscid wall — the body surface;
  • 外圈（8 条边）：远场特征边界。
  • Outer ring (8 edges): far-field characteristic boundary.

有限体积法需要一组不重叠、铺满全域的控制体。把未知量放在单元里，控制体就是单元本身（格心格式）；也可以把未知量放在节点上，这时控制体必须另外造出来，做法是围绕每个节点“切”出一块，这就是中位对偶控制体（）。本页采用后者，所以 N=24。

A finite-volume method needs a set of control volumes that do not overlap and cover the whole domain. Put the unknowns in the cells and the control volume is the cell itself (the cell-centred scheme); put them on the nodes instead and the control volumes have to be constructed, by "cutting" a piece out around every node — the median-dual control volume (). This page takes the latter, so N=24.

一步一步围出控制体

Building a control volume step by step

构造规则只有一条，而且对三角形和四边形完全一样：在每个单元内，把每条边的中点与单元中心相连。这些线段把单元分成若干块，分别归属它的各个顶点；把所有相邻单元里属于同一个节点的小块拼起来，就是这个节点的控制体。 可以逐步播放这个过程，也可以点击任意节点换一个看（试试壁面节点、远场节点和内部节点的区别）。

There is only one construction rule, and it is exactly the same for triangles and quadrilaterals: inside each cell, join the midpoint of every edge to the cell centre. Those segments cut the cell into pieces, each belonging to one of its vertices; collect the pieces belonging to the same node across all its neighbouring cells and you have that node’s control volume. plays the process step by step, and any node can be clicked to see another one (try the difference between a wall node, a far-field node and an interior node).

对偶面与它的法向

The dual face and its normal

网格的每一条边 (i,j) 对应一个对偶面：它由相邻单元各贡献的一段拼成——内部边有两个相邻单元，所以对偶面是折线 xc1→m→xc2；边界边只有一个单元，只贡献一段。面的法向由各段旋转 90° 后相加得到（）：

Every edge (i,j) of the mesh corresponds to one dual face, assembled from one segment contributed by each adjacent cell — an interior edge has two adjacent cells, so the dual face is the polyline xc1→m→xc2; a boundary edge has only one cell and contributes a single segment. The face normal is obtained by rotating each segment through 90° and adding them ():

nij=Σt∋(i,j)±(dy,−dx),d=xc−m,m=12(xi+xj),

符号取成让 nij 由节点 i 指向节点 j。这样一条边只需要存一个法向向量。|nij| 是这条折线的等效直线长度——等于折线两端之间的距离（内部边就是两个单元中心；边界边的对偶面只有一段，两端是边中点与那一个单元中心），而不是折线自身的长度（算例中折线最多长 13.4%）。通量只用到矢量 nij，所以边循环和格心格式的面循环形式完全一样。

The sign is chosen so that nij points from node i to node j. An edge then needs to store just one normal vector. |nij| is the equivalent straight-face length of that polyline — the distance between its two ends (for an interior edge, the two cell centres; the dual face of a boundary edge has a single segment, running from the edge midpoint to its one cell centre), not the polyline's own length, which runs up to 13.4% longer in this mesh. The flux only ever uses the vector nij, which is why the edge loop has exactly the same form as the face loop of a cell-centred scheme.

四边形的一个重要差别。中点—中心连线把三角形恰好分成面积相等的三块，所以三角形网格上 Vi=13Σ(相邻三角形面积)。但对一般四边形，四块面积并不相等（只有平行四边形才是四分之一）。所以控制体体积必须把各个子块的面积逐个加起来，不能套用固定分数——(b) 给出了算例中真实四边形的四块占比。

One important difference for quadrilaterals. The midpoint-to-centre lines cut a triangle into three pieces of exactly equal area, so on a triangular mesh Vi=13Σ(area of the adjacent triangles). For a general quadrilateral, though, the four pieces are not equal (only a parallelogram gives quarters). So the control-volume area has to be accumulated piece by piece and cannot be taken as a fixed fraction — (b) gives the four shares for a real quadrilateral from the test case.

边界节点：用半条边把控制体封口

Boundary nodes: sealing the control volume with half-edges

内部节点的控制体被相邻单元内的线段完整围住，边界节点却不是：它的控制体在区域边界上是“敞开”的，必须用节点到相邻边界边中点的两条半边补上（）。这两条半边就是边界半面，外法向取该边界边外法向的一半：

The control volume of an interior node is enclosed completely by the segments inside its neighbouring cells; a boundary node’s is not — it is left "open" along the domain boundary and has to be closed with the two half-edges running from the node to the midpoints of its adjacent boundary edges (). Those two half-edges are the boundary half-faces, and their outward normal is half the outward normal of the boundary edge:

nbnd=12(yb−ya,−(xb−xa)),

边界边 (a,b) 的两个端点各得一份。算例中内外圈各有 8 条边界边，共 16 条，所以有 32 个边界半面（16 个壁面 + 16 个远场）；加上 48 条边对应的 48 个内部对偶面，边循环一共要走 80 个面。

Each of the two endpoints of a boundary edge (a,b) receives one share. The test case has 8 boundary edges on the inner ring and 8 on the outer, 16 in all, giving 32 boundary half-faces (16 wall + 16 far-field); together with the 48 interior dual faces of the 48 edges, the edge loop walks 80 faces in total.

闭合性。每个控制体是一个封闭多边形，所以它全部外法向之和为零。选中任一节点，把它“作为 i”的面取 +n、“作为 j”的面取 −n（边界半面取 +n）相加，结果都是 (0,0)——上面的信息栏里可以直接读到（“Σ 外法向”一行）。这一点对四边形和三角形同样成立。

Closure. Every control volume is a closed polygon, so all its outward normals sum to zero. Select any node, add +n for the faces where it acts as i and −n for those where it acts as j (boundary half-faces take +n), and the result is always (0,0) — the construction demo above () reads it out directly, on its "Σ outward normals" row. This holds for quadrilaterals and triangles alike.

网格：保留原来的混合 O 型网格

Mesh: retain the original hybrid O-grid

仍使用原来的 24 个节点、8 个四边形和 16 个三角形，内外边界的坐标与连接关系不变。改变的是边界的数学含义和空间重构，不是重建一个新的几何算例。数组在本页新增交互中从 0 开始编号。

The original 24 nodes, eight quadrilaterals and sixteen triangles remain unchanged, including boundary coordinates and connectivity. We change the boundary interpretation and spatial reconstruction, not the geometry. New interactive arrays use zero-based indexing.

未知量放在原始节点。每个对偶控制体由节点、边中点和原始单元中心连接而成；内部对偶面可能由两段折线组成。一阶沿用合成法向的旧通量；二阶在各段上分别重构和积分，不能把不同位置的面值用一个中点代替。

Unknowns live at primal nodes. Dual volumes join nodes, edge midpoints and primal-cell centres. An interior dual face may have two segments. First order retains the original summed-normal flux; second order reconstructs and integrates each segment separately. Distinct trace locations cannot be represented by a single midpoint.

nf=(yb−ya,−(xb−xa)),ℓf=∥nf∥,∑f∈∂Vinif=0.\boldsymbol n_f=(y_b-y_a,-(x_b-x_a)),\quad\ell_f=\|\boldsymbol n_f\|,\quad\sum_{f\in\partial V_i}\boldsymbol n_{if}=0.

第 2 节
Section 2

要离散的方程与对偶面上的一维通量

The equation to discretise, and the one-dimensional flux on a dual face

要离散的方程

The equation to discretise

为什么用标量方程，而不是 Euler / N–S。本页要讲的是离散伴随的结构：边循环怎么写、怎么对它逐项求导、怎么把它转置。真实的 Euler 方程在每个对偶面上的通量是 4 维（二维）或 5 维（三维）的向量，它的局部导数是 4×4 或 5×5 的块，再加上 Roe 的特征分解、限制器、N–S 的粘性项与湍流模型，∂h/∂uL 就从一个数变成一个矩阵——这些细节会把“收集—计算—分发”这条主线淹没。换成标量守恒律之后，两个局部导数 ∂h/∂uL、∂h/∂uR 各自只是一个数，整条链路才能逐句播放、逐项和差分对照。但骨架完全一样：边循环的写法、边界条件只在一维通量内部起作用、前向与伴随的转置关系，在真实求解器里逐字成立——把标量换成状态向量、把局部导数换成块矩阵即可。

Why a scalar equation rather than Euler / N–S. What this page is about is the structure of the discrete adjoint: how the edge loop is written, how it is differentiated term by term, how it is transposed. In the real Euler equations the flux on each dual face is a 4-vector (two-dimensional) or 5-vector (three-dimensional) whose local derivatives are 4×4 or 5×5 blocks, and with Roe’s characteristic decomposition, limiters, the N–S viscous terms and a turbulence model on top, ∂h/∂uL turns from a number into a matrix — details that would drown the "gather — compute — scatter" thread. With a scalar conservation law the two local derivatives ∂h/∂uL and ∂h/∂uR are each just one number, so the whole chain can be played statement by statement and checked term by term against differences. But the skeleton is identical: how the edge loop is written, the fact that boundary conditions act inside the one-dimensional flux, and the transpose relation between forward and adjoint all hold verbatim in a real solver — replace the scalar by a state vector and the local derivatives by block matrices.

本页要离散的是二维标量守恒律：

The page discretises a two-dimensional scalar conservation law:

∂u∂t+∇·F(u)=0,F(u)=12u2β,β=(1,0.5).

通量 F 对 u 是非线性的（∂F/∂u=uβ），所以离散之后得到的 R(u) 同样非线性——这正是后面要迭代求解、并在收敛状态 u* 处线性化的原因。

The flux F is nonlinear in u (with ∂F/∂u=uβ), so the discrete R(u) is nonlinear too — which is exactly why it is solved below by iteration and linearised at the converged state u*.

有限体积离散

Finite-volume discretisation

在节点 i 的对偶控制体上积分并用高斯公式，体积分变成对偶控制体边界上的通量之和：

Integrating over the dual control volume of node i and applying the divergence theorem turns the volume integral into a sum of fluxes over the boundary of that dual control volume:

Viduidt+Ri(u)=0,Ri=Σe∋i±He.

到这里，空间离散剩下的唯一问题就是：一个对偶面上的 He 怎么算。

At this point the only question left in the spatial discretisation is how to evaluate He on a single dual face.

为了方便说明，本页采用一阶空间离散。面上的左右状态直接取两侧节点当前的值，不做任何重构——也就是把解看成分片常数，因此空间精度是一阶的。真实求解器会在这一步加上二阶重构（MUSCL 或最小二乘梯度）再配一个限制器，那会带来两件事：一是模板从“两侧节点”扩大到邻居的邻居，面通量的局部导数不再只涉及两个节点；二是限制器通常不可微，实用做法是把它在 u* 处冻结——与第 3 节远场入流/出流开关的处理完全一样。但边循环、前向、伴随的结构一点不变：仍然是收集 → 算一维通量 → 分发，仍然靠转置得到伴随。一阶的代价只体现在精度上，不体现在本页要讲的那套代数上。

For ease of explanation this page uses a first-order spatial discretisation. The left and right states on a face are taken straight from the current values at the two nodes, with no reconstruction at all — the solution is treated as piecewise constant, so the spatial accuracy is first order. A real solver would add second-order reconstruction here (MUSCL or a least-squares gradient) together with a limiter, and that brings two things: the stencil grows from "the two nodes" to the neighbours’ neighbours, so the local derivatives of a face flux involve more than two nodes; and a limiter is usually not differentiable, the practical remedy being to freeze it at u* — exactly as the far-field inflow/outflow switch is treated in Section 3. But the structure of the edge loop, of the forward mode and of the adjoint does not change at all: still gather → evaluate the one-dimensional flux → scatter, still transpose to get the adjoint. First order costs accuracy only, and none of the algebra this page is about.

每个对偶面都是一个一维问题

Every dual face is a one-dimensional problem

通过一个面的通量只和法向分量 F·n 有关。沿法向看，面两侧就是一维问题：左边常数状态 uL，右边常数状态 uR（）。数值通量取左右平均 − 常数耗散系数 ×（右状态 − 左状态）：

The flux through a face depends only on the normal component F·n. Along the normal, the two sides of the face form a one-dimensional problem: a constant state uL on the left and a constant state uR on the right (). The numerical flux is taken as the average of the two sides − a constant dissipation coefficient × (right state − left state):

H(uL,uR)=12[F(uL)+F(uR)]·n左右平均−ε|n|(uR−uL)常数耗散,ε=0.8.
H(uL,uR)=12[F(uL)+F(uR)]·naverage−ε|n|(uR−uL)dissipation,ε=0.8.

记 vn=β·n，由 F(u)·n=12u2vn，中心项就是 14vn(uL2+uR2)。在里拖动滑块，观察两项如何组成通量。以下把对偶面上的这个数记作 h=H(uL,uR)。

Writing vn=β·n and using F(u)·n=12u2vn, the central term is 14vn(uL2+uR2). Drag the sliders in to watch how the two terms make up the flux. From here on this number on a dual face is written h=H(uL,uR).

方程、数值通量与一阶／二阶重构

Equation, numerical flux and first/second-order reconstruction

方程和内部数值通量形式保持不变：β=(1,0.5)、ε=0.8。u 是正的标量，不是二维速度。非线性来自 u²；特征方向与 β 一致，特征速度大小随 u 改变。此处只研究光滑正解，不加入激波或限制器。

Keep the equation and interior flux form: β=(1,0.5), ε=0.8. The positive scalar u is not a two-dimensional velocity. Nonlinearity comes from u²: characteristics follow β, with speed depending on u. This example studies smooth positive solutions only, without shocks or limiters.

∇⋅(u22β)=0,Hf=β⋅nf4[(uf−)2+(uf+)2]−εℓf(uf+−uf−).\nabla\cdot\left(\frac{u^2}{2}\boldsymbol\beta\right)=0,\qquad H_f=\frac{\boldsymbol\beta\cdot\boldsymbol n_f}{4}\big[(u_f^-)^2+(u_f^+)^2\big]-\varepsilon\ell_f(u_f^+-u_f^-).
ui(xf)=ui+∇hui⋅(xf−xi),Mi∇hui=bi,Mi=∑j∈NiwijdijdijT,bi=∑j∈Niwijdij(uj−ui),wij=1/∥dij∥2.u_i(x_f)=u_i+\nabla_hu_i\cdot(x_f-x_i),\quad M_i\nabla_hu_i=b_i,\quad M_i=\sum_{j\in N_i}w_{ij}d_{ij}d_{ij}^T,\quad b_i=\sum_{j\in N_i}w_{ij}d_{ij}(u_j-u_i),\quad w_{ij}=1/\|d_{ij}\|^2.

一阶把梯度设为零，直接使用控制体值。二阶由相邻控制体做距离加权最小二乘，求一个 2×2 系统；每条直线段采用两点 Gauss 积分。若 u 是线性函数，梯度应精确恢复到舍入误差；这是重构实现的第一道检查。节点坐标改变时，d、w、M、b 以及重构位置全部参与求导。

First order sets gradients to zero. Second order uses inverse-distance-squared weighted least squares over adjacent control volumes, solving a 2×2 system, followed by two-point Gauss quadrature on each straight segment. Linear fields should reproduce their gradients to roundoff. Geometry derivatives include d, w, M, b and reconstruction locations.

for unknown i:
    M = sum(w * outer(dx,dx))
    b = sum(w * dx * (u[j]-u[i]))
    grad[i] = solve2(M,b) if order==2 else [0,0]
for face segment:
    for Gauss point xq:
        uL = u[L] + dot(grad[L],xq-x[L])
        uR = reconstruct_neighbor_or_apply_boundary(xq)
        H += weight * numerical_flux(uL,uR,normal)

为什么梯度来自一个小线性系统？把每个邻点的增量 u_j−u_i 近似为 d_ij·g_i，最小化加权平方误差。令对 g_i 的导数为零，就得到上面的正规方程。二维至少需要两个不共线的方向；det M 接近零意味着邻域无法可靠确定某个方向的梯度。交互表列出实际 M、行列式和各邻点增量。

Why a small linear system? Approximate each neighbour jump u_j−u_i by d_ij·g_i and minimise the weighted squared mismatch. Setting its derivative with respect to g_i to zero gives the normal equations above. Two dimensions require at least two non-collinear directions; a nearly zero determinant means that the stencil cannot reliably resolve one gradient component. The panel shows the actual matrix, determinant and neighbour jumps.

min⁡gi12∑j∈Niwij[dij⋅gi−(uj−ui)]2,xq±=xa+xb2±xb−xa23.\min_{g_i}\frac12\sum_{j\in N_i}w_{ij}\left[d_{ij}\cdot g_i-(u_j-u_i)\right]^2,\quad x_{q\pm}=\frac{x_a+x_b}{2}\pm\frac{x_b-x_a}{2\sqrt3}.

通量的第一项近似物理输运，第二项抑制相邻状态的非物理振荡。ε 固定为 0.8，不对谱半径取最大值，因此这里没有波速选择分支。二阶改的是两个面迹的近似及积分；不会把 ε 简单除以网格尺度。边界值和耗散同样逐积分点求值。

The first flux term approximates physical transport; the second damps nonphysical inter-state oscillation. The fixed ε=0.8 avoids a spectral-radius maximum branch. Second order changes traces and quadrature, not ε by an arbitrary mesh scaling. Boundary data and dissipation are evaluated at each quadrature point.

第 3 节
Section 3

边界条件

Boundary conditions

内圈和外圈的物理意义完全不同，处理方式也不同。两者都只在上一节那个一维通量内部起作用：边界半面没有“右节点”，远场由边界条件给出右状态 uR，无粘壁面则直接令 h=0。把各个对偶面的通量拼成残差的边循环在第 4 节展开——它本身一行都不用改。

The inner and outer rings mean quite different things physically, and are treated differently. Both act only inside the one-dimensional flux of the previous section: a boundary half-face has no "right node", so at the far field the boundary condition supplies the right state uR, while the inviscid wall sets h=0 outright. The edge loop that assembles the fluxes of all the dual faces into the residual is unfolded in Section 4 — it needs no change at all.

内圈：无粘壁面

Inner ring: the inviscid wall

无粘壁面的物理条件是无穿透：流体不能穿过物面。对本页的标量模型，这意味着通过壁面的对流通量直接为零：

The physical condition at an inviscid wall is no penetration: fluid cannot cross the body surface. For the scalar model on this page that means the convective flux through the wall is simply zero:

hwall=0.

于是壁面半面不改变残差——它只负责把控制体封口（）。这一点在第 4 节的演示里可以直接看到：播放到壁面半面时，h=0（）。

So a wall half-face does not change the residual — its only job is to seal the control volume (). This is directly visible in the demo of Section 4: when the play reaches a wall half-face, h=0 ().

外圈：远场特征边界

Outer ring: the far-field characteristic boundary

远场要按特征方向决定用哪一侧的信息。标量守恒律 F(u)=12u2β 的波速是 uvn（vn=β·n，n 指向域外）。算例中 u>0，所以 sign(uvn)=sign(vn)，判据是纯几何的：

At the far field the characteristic direction decides which side supplies the information. The wave speed of the scalar law F(u)=12u2β is uvn (with vn=β·n and n pointing out of the domain). In the test case u>0, so sign(uvn)=sign(vn) and the test is purely geometric:

  • 入流（vn<0，特征从域外进来）：右状态取自由来流 uR=u∞=1.0；
  • Inflow (vn<0, the characteristic enters from outside): the right state is the free stream, uR=u∞=1.0;
  • 出流（vn≥0，特征从域内出去）：右状态由内部外推，uR=uL。
  • Outflow (vn≥0, the characteristic leaves the domain): the right state is extrapolated from inside, uR=uL.

算例的 8 条远场边里 4 条入流、4 条出流（）。开关在冻结状态 u* 处固定（frozen switch），前向与伴随都在这个固定的分支上线性化。

Of the 8 far-field edges in the test case, 4 are inflow and 4 outflow (). The switch is fixed at the frozen state u* (a frozen switch), and both the forward and the adjoint mode linearise on that fixed branch.

这是把边界条件收在右状态与一维通量这一层的好处：边循环的骨架——收集、算通量、分发——与边界种类无关（代码里这些分支都在 flux 一侧，下面的清单把它们逐行摊开，只为能逐句播放）。

That is the benefit of keeping the boundary conditions at the level of the right state and the one-dimensional flux: the skeleton of the edge loop — gather, evaluate, scatter — does not depend on how many kinds of boundary there are (in the code these branches all sit on the flux side; the listing below spells them out line by line only so they can be played statement by statement).

为什么这里没有无滑移壁面。本页的方程是纯对流的（无粘）：边界上只能在特征进入区域的地方给数据。物面是一条闭合曲线，β 是常数，所以 β·n 沿物面必然有正有负（本算例 u>0，特征速度 uβ·n 也是如此）；在特征离开区域的那部分物面上再规定 u=uw，问题就多给了一个条件：没有扩散，那里没有任何机制能把壁面值带进流场。无滑移这类 Dirichlet 壁面条件属于带扩散项的方程——拉普拉斯算子是二阶的，它让 u=uw 在整条物面上都适定。所以壁面上的 Dirichlet 条件放在另一对页面里讲：二维标量对流扩散方程（格点）。

Why there is no no-slip wall here. The equation on this page is purely convective (inviscid): boundary data can be given only where characteristics enter the domain. The body is a closed curve and β is constant, so β·n must take both signs along it (with u>0 in this test case, so does the characteristic speed uβ·n); prescribing u=uw where characteristics leave the domain gives the problem one condition too many: without diffusion nothing can carry the wall value into the flow there. A Dirichlet wall such as no-slip belongs to an equation with diffusion — the Laplacian is second order, and it makes u=uw well posed along the whole wall. So the Dirichlet wall is the subject of another pair of pages: the two-dimensional scalar advection–diffusion equation (node-centred).

新增：光滑特征边界模型
Added: smooth characteristic-boundary model

边界条件：内外边界统一按特征方向处理

Boundaries: characteristic conditions on both inner and outer boundaries

新增模型不使用零通量分支；本节上方保留原模型供对照。保持固定 β 时，封闭边界不可能处处与 β 相切；强制 u²β·n/2=0 会在非切向位置要求 u=0，与光滑正值参考不相容。现在内边界允许标量通量通过，称为“内边界”，不再称为不可穿透固壁。法向始终指向计算域外，内边界法向因此指向孔洞。

The added model does not use the zero-flux branch; the original model above is retained for comparison. A fixed β cannot be tangent everywhere to a closed contour, so u²β·n/2=0 would require u=0 where β·n is nonzero, contradicting a smooth positive reference. The inner boundary now transmits scalar flux and is not an impermeable wall. Normals point out of the computational domain, hence into the hole at the inner boundary.

ue(x,y)=a+0.2sin⁡[π(y−0.5x)],a=1,β⋅∇ue=0,∇⋅(12ue2β)=0.u_e(x,y)=a+0.2\sin[\pi(y-0.5x)],\quad a=1,\quad \boldsymbol\beta\cdot\nabla u_e=0,\quad\nabla\cdot\left(\tfrac12u_e^2\boldsymbol\beta\right)=0.
uf+={g(xf,yf)=ue(xf,yf),β⋅nf<0,uf−,β⋅nf≥0.u_f^+=\begin{cases}g(x_f,y_f)=u_e(x_f,y_f),&\boldsymbol\beta\cdot\boldsymbol n_f<0,\\u_f^-,&\boldsymbol\beta\cdot\boldsymbol n_f\ge0.\end{cases}

入流给定函数 g，出流由内部解决定；不在出流再指定一个 Dirichlet 值。内外入流都取同一个解析场，因而特征线穿过孔洞后重新进入计算域时不会引入不匹配的数据。二阶在每个 Gauss 点计算 g，不把它冻结为面中心常数。几何扰动必须包含 δg=∇g·δx_f+δa。

Specify g on inflow and let the interior determine outflow; do not impose another Dirichlet value there. Both inner and outer inflow sample the same analytic field, avoiding incompatible data when a characteristic re-enters after crossing the hole. Second order evaluates g at each Gauss point. Geometry perturbations include δg=∇g·δx_f+δa.

第 4 节
Section 4

残差 = 边循环：收集、计算、分发

The residual = the edge loop: gather, compute, scatter

先固定离散问题与符号

Fix the discrete problem and its notation

本页每个节点存储 1 个未知量。以下用粗体 U_h 表示把所有位置、所有分量按代码顺序排成的列向量；标量问题也采用这个统一记号。它不是连续函数 U(x)。下标 h 表示固定网格及固定空间格式，而不是差分验证中的参数步长。物理方程中的空间导数只用于说明模型；求离散伴随时，求导对象是本页实际装配的有限维函数。

Each node stores 1 unknown. Below, bold U_h stacks all locations and components in code order, including for scalar problems. It is not a continuous function U(x). The subscript h labels the fixed mesh and spatial scheme, not the parameter step in finite-difference checks. Spatial derivatives in the physical equations explain the model; discrete differentiation acts on the actual finite-dimensional functions assembled on this page.

Uh∈Rnu,a∈Rna,Rh:Rnu×Rna→Rnu,Jh:Rnu×Rna→R.\mathbf U_h\in\mathbb R^{n_u},\quad a\in\mathbb R^{n_a},\quad R_h:\mathbb R^{n_u}\times\mathbb R^{n_a}\to\mathbb R^{n_u},\quad J_h:\mathbb R^{n_u}\times\mathbb R^{n_a}\to\mathbb R.

a 统一代表本页的设计变量（原文中的 p、b 或坐标 X），不是声速。原文中省略 h 的 R、J、A 在离散推导中分别指 R_h、J_h、A_h。系统方程中的局部 U_i 是一个小列向量；全局 U_h 才是 Jacobian 的输入。截面积、通量 Jacobian、全局残差 Jacobian 必须按定义区分，不能因为都曾简写为 A 而混用。

Here a denotes the page’s design variables (p, b or coordinates X in the original notation), not sound speed. In discrete derivations, unadorned R, J and A mean R_h, J_h and A_h. A local U_i is a small column vector; the global U_h is the residual Jacobian input. Cross-sectional area, a flux Jacobian and the global residual Jacobian are distinct objects even when earlier formulas use the letter A.

Ah=∂Rh∂Uh∈Rnu×nu,Ch=∂Rh∂a∈Rnu×na,jU=∇UhJh∈Rnu,ja=∇aJh∈Rna.A_h=\frac{\partial R_h}{\partial\mathbf U_h}\in\mathbb R^{n_u\times n_u},\quad C_h=\frac{\partial R_h}{\partial a}\in\mathbb R^{n_u\times n_a},\quad j_U=\nabla_{\mathbf U_h}J_h\in\mathbb R^{n_u},\quad j_a=\nabla_aJ_h\in\mathbb R^{n_a}.

这里 j_U、j_a 都是列向量。若原文写 J_U 或 J_a 表示偏导数行，则 J_U=j_Uᵀ、J_a=j_aᵀ；部分旧图中的 g 是状态梯度 j_U，不是最后的设计梯度。δ 表示对有限个输入的方向扰动，上横线表示反向累加权重；这两个记号本身并不意味着连续伴随。

Both j_U and j_a are columns. A derivative row J_U or J_a equals j_Uᵀ or j_aᵀ. The g in some earlier diagrams denotes the state gradient j_U, not the final design gradient. A delta denotes a direction in the finite input space and an overbar a reverse accumulation weight; neither symbol by itself implies a continuous adjoint.

残差计算对每条边做三件事：从两端节点收集状态，调用一维通量计算 h，再把 h 分发回两个节点——节点 i 加、节点 j 减。同一个 h 以相反符号进入两个控制体，这就是守恒。

Computing the residual does three things on every edge: gather the states from the two nodes, call the one-dimensional flux to compute h, and scatter h back to the two nodes — added at node i, subtracted at node j. The same h enters the two control volumes with opposite signs, and that is conservation.

反过来看一个节点：它的残差就是自己所有对偶面的通量之和，符号由它在每个面上是 i 还是 j 决定（）。内部节点的面数等于它的相邻节点数，随网格而变——这是节点中心格式与格心格式在数据结构上的主要差别。

Seen from a node instead: its residual is the sum of the fluxes of all its own dual faces, each signed by whether the node is i or j on that face (). An interior node has as many faces as it has neighbouring nodes, which varies across the mesh — the main data-structure difference between a node-centred and a cell-centred scheme.

逐句执行这个循环。网格上：紫色是当前对偶面，箭头从节点指向面（收集）、再从面指向节点（分发）。面板底部是两条数组：上面是输入的节点状态，下面是正在累加的残差。可以按 ▶ 连续播放，也可以用“下一步”或键盘左右键逐句走，或用右上角的下拉框直接跳到某个面（例如跳到一个壁面半面，看无粘壁面的 h=0）。

executes this loop statement by statement. On the mesh: violet is the current dual face, and the arrows run from the nodes to the face (gather) and back from the face to the nodes (scatter). At the bottom of the panel are two arrays: above, the input node states; below, the residual being accumulated. You can press ▶ to play continuously, step through statement by statement with "next" or the left and right arrow keys, or jump straight to a face with the dropdown at the top right (for example to a wall half-face, to see h=0 on an inviscid wall).

新增：光滑特征边界模型
Added: smooth characteristic-boundary model

残差：梯度收集、面计算与守恒分发

Residual: gradient gathering, face evaluation and conservative scatter

残差仍是流出通量的积分和，不除以体积。本例没有源项。内部面向左加 H、向右减 H，因此全域求和时内部贡献抵消，只剩边界通量。二阶先计算所有梯度，再做面循环；格点面分段的每一份贡献都向同一对控制体守恒分发。

The residual remains the sum of integrated outward fluxes, without volume normalisation. There is no source. Each internal face adds H to the left and subtracts H from the right, so global summation cancels interior contributions and leaves boundary flux. Second order computes gradients before the face loop; every dual-face segment conservatively scatters to the same adjacent volumes.

Ri(u,X,a)=∑fBifHf,BLf=+1,  BRf=−1,R(u∗,X,a)=0.R_i(u,X,a)=\sum_f B_{if}H_f,\quad B_{Lf}=+1,\;B_{Rf}=-1,\qquad R(u^*,X,a)=0.
grad = least_squares(u, coordinates)
R[:] = 0
for f in computational_faces:
    H = integrate_reconstructed_flux(f,grad)
    R[L] += H
    if R exists: R[R] -= H
# No special zero-flux branch on the inner boundary.
第 5 节
Section 5

求解：Jacobian 与 Jacobi 迭代

The solve: the Jacobian and Jacobi iteration

从残差到 Jacobian

From residual to Jacobian

第 4 节的 residual(u) 就是离散残差 R(u)∈ℝN，每个分量对应一个节点。它的 Jacobian 矩阵 A=∂R/∂u 是 N×N 的（算例中 24×24）。本节先把它显式写出来，看清它的结构；下面求解 R(u)=0 只用到它的对角元，第 7、8 节再讲怎样不形成 A 也能乘它。

The residual(u) of Section 4 is the discrete residual R(u)∈ℝN, with one component per node. Its Jacobian A=∂R/∂u is N×N (24×24 in the test case). This section writes it out explicitly, to show its structure; solving R(u)=0 below needs only its diagonal, and Sections 7 and 8 show how to multiply by A without ever forming it.

A 的每一份贡献都来自一个对偶面：对第 2 节那个一维通量求局部导数，

Every contribution to A comes from one dual face: differentiate the one-dimensional flux of Section 2 locally,

cL=∂h∂uL=12vnuL+ε|n|,cR=∂h∂uR=12vnuR−ε|n|.

再把这两个数按和残差完全相同的符号累加到 A 的四个位置：ALL+=cL、ALR+=cR、ARL−=cL、ARR−=cR。边界半面只有 L 一侧，所以只落在 ALL 上。

and accumulate those two numbers into four entries of A with exactly the signs the residual used: ALL+=cL, ALR+=cR, ARL−=cL, ARR−=cR. A boundary half-face has only an L side, so it lands on ALL alone.

出流半面的导数为什么会“合并”。出流时 uR=uL，同一个 uL 同时进入通量的两个槽位，链式法则要把两个局部导数相加，耗散项正好抵消：

Why the derivatives "merge" on an outflow half-face. At outflow uR=uL, so the same uL enters both slots of the flux; the chain rule adds the two local derivatives and the dissipation terms cancel exactly:

cL=(12vnuL+ε|n|)∂h/∂uL+(12vnuL−ε|n|)∂h/∂uR=vnuL.

于是边界半面对 A 的贡献全都只落在 ALL 上，边界条件决定的只是这一项的大小：无粘壁面 cL=cR=0；入流 uR=u∞ 是常数，cR=0，只剩 cL；出流按上式合并成 vnuL。 在真实网格上对照壁面节点与外圈节点。

So a boundary half-face reaches A only through ALL, and the boundary condition decides only how large that entry is: an inviscid wall gives cL=cR=0; at inflow uR=u∞ is a constant, so cR=0 and only cL remains; at outflow the two merge into vnuL as above. compares a wall node with the outer nodes on the real mesh.

这也把第 2 节的一阶、无重构落到了实处：算例中 A 共 120 个非零元，没有一个落在相邻节点之外（每个节点有 3–5 个相邻节点）。

This also pins down the first-order, no-reconstruction claim of Section 2: in the test case A has 120 non-zeros and not one of them falls outside the neighbouring nodes (each node has 3–5 of them).

怎么把 R(u)=0 解出来

How R(u)=0 is actually solved

上面已经把 residual(u) 和它的 Jacobian 都造出来了，却还没有说这个非线性方程组是怎么解开的。本页的 primal 方程、切线方程和伴随方程（切线在第 9 节，伴随在第 10 节）用的是同一个 Jacobi 迭代：每一轮算一次残差，再逐节点除以 Jacobian 的对角元：

Both residual(u) and its Jacobian have now been built, but nothing has yet been said about how the nonlinear system is solved. On this page the primal equation, the tangent equation and the adjoint equation (Sections 9 and 10) are all solved by one and the same Jacobi iteration: every sweep evaluates the residual once and divides it, node by node, by the diagonal of the Jacobian:

uk+1=uk−D(uk)−1R(uk)
D=diag(A),A=∂R∂u

D 不需要把 A 造出来：diagonal(u) 就是残差的那个边循环，每个面只把 cL 加到左节点、把 −cR 加到右节点，也就是它在 A 里的四个元素中落在对角线上的那两个。所以一轮只有一次 residual 和一次 diagonal：不形成矩阵，也不解线性方程组，每个节点各自更新。初值取均匀来流 u0≡1，判据是残差的均方根 ‖R‖<10−13（）。

D does not need A to be formed: diagonal(u) is the residual's own edge loop, in which each face adds only cL to its left node and −cR to its right node, the two of its four entries in A that land on the diagonal. So a sweep is one residual and one diagonal: no matrix is formed and no linear system is solved; every node is updated on its own. The initial guess is the uniform free stream u0≡1, and the criterion is the rms of the residual, ‖R‖<10−13 ().

为什么用 Jacobi，而不用 LU。本页只有 24 个未知量，理论上最快的办法是直接分解：把 A 整个造出来，用 Newton 法，每一步做一次稠密 LU 分解，k=4 时残差就已低于 10−13。可那样就说明不了 matrix-free。Jacobi 是最简单的迭代法：对 A 它只要对角元，其余的一切都经由残差作用进来（切线方程里是 residual_d，伴随方程里是 residual_b），这正是 matrix-free 的意思。代价是线性收敛：在解附近，误差每一轮乘以迭代矩阵 I−D−1A，速率由它的谱半径决定，本算例是 0.797，判据在 k=122 时满足。切线与伴随的迭代矩阵与它同谱，所以进入渐近阶段以后，三条收敛曲线以同一个速率下降（第 9、10 节）。

Why Jacobi, and not LU. With only 24 unknowns the fastest method in principle is a direct factorisation: form the whole of A, run Newton, and factorise with one dense LU per step; the residual is below 10−13 by k=4. But that would show nothing about matrix-free. Jacobi is the simplest iterative method there is: of A it needs only the diagonal, and everything else comes in through the residual (through residual_d in the tangent equation and residual_b in the adjoint equation), which is exactly what matrix-free means. The price is linear convergence: near the solution the error is multiplied every sweep by the iteration matrix I−D−1A, at a rate set by its spectral radius, 0.797 here, and the criterion is met at k=122. The tangent and adjoint iteration matrices have the same spectrum, so once in the asymptotic phase all three convergence curves fall at the same rate (Sections 9 and 10).

固定轮次，但会检查。代码固定跑 300 轮，而不是一满足判据就退出：余下的轮次把 u* 一直带到舍入误差平台（从 k=153 起），页面上每一个实测常数都是在这些轮次下量出来的；得到的 u* 与 Newton 法的解最多差 4.4×10−16。真正要紧的是有没有检查：它记录判据在第几轮满足，若 300 轮内从未满足就直接报错，而不会把一个未收敛的状态当成 u* 返回。

A fixed sweep count, but a checked one. The code runs a fixed 300 sweeps rather than exiting at the criterion: the remaining sweeps take u* down to its round-off floor (from k=153 on), and every measured constant on this page was produced under those sweeps; the u* it returns is within 4.4×10−16 of Newton's. What actually matters is whether it is checked: it records the sweep at which the criterion was met, and raises an error if 300 sweeps never meet it, rather than returning an unconverged state as u*.

State of the test case

用 Jacobi 迭代求解 R(u)=0 得到收敛解 u*：

此后 u* 冻结：前向与伴随都是在这个状态上的线性化。 播放到最后，就能看到残差逐面累加、最终抵消为零的过程。

Jacobian 与原始求解

Jacobian and primal solution

一阶保留原来的 Jacobi 形式 u←u−D⁻¹R，D 是一阶残差 Jacobian 的对角。边界数据变了，收敛流场和旧版常数当然也随之改变。二阶精确 Jacobian 包含重构邻点，不能只沿用原来的两个面邻点导数。

First order retains u←u−D⁻¹R with the first-order residual Jacobian diagonal. The changed boundary data naturally changes the converged field and old quoted numbers. The second-order exact Jacobian includes reconstruction neighbours; the original two face-state derivatives alone are insufficient.

二阶使用带回溯的 Newton 修正，线性系统由 GS 预处理 GMRES 求解。预处理仅保留一阶近似，执行三次 GS 扫描；外层乘积始终使用完整二阶残差的精确前向算子。回溯检查未知量和面重构状态为正，并要求真残差下降。精确算子没有组装成全局矩阵。

Second order uses backtracked Newton corrections solved by GS-preconditioned GMRES. Three GS sweeps of a first-order approximation form the preconditioner; outer products always use the exact derivative of the second-order residual. Backtracking requires positive unknowns and face traces and a decrease in the true residual. The exact global matrix is not assembled.

AΔu=−R,A=Ru,unew=u+αΔu,P≈A from first order.A\Delta u=-R,\quad A=R_u,\quad u^{new}=u+\alpha\Delta u,\quad P\approx A\text{ from first order}.

先看一阶的一次 Jacobi：所有分量都从同一轮旧状态计算 R 与 D，然后同时更新。它不同于立即覆盖分量的 GS。对内部面，两个状态导数为 c_L 和 c_R；左单元对角加 c_L，右单元对角减 c_R。入流外侧 g 与状态无关；出流 u⁺=u⁻，必须把 c_L+c_R 合并到同一个对角项。

A first-order Jacobi sweep evaluates R and D from the same old state, then updates all components simultaneously. GS instead immediately reuses updated components. For an interior face, add c_L to the left diagonal and −c_R to the right diagonal. Inflow g is independent of the state; outflow has u⁺=u⁻, so c_L+c_R belongs on a single diagonal entry.

uik+1=uik−Ri(uk)Di(uk),zim+1=bi−∑j<iPijzjm+1−∑j>iPijzjmPii.u_i^{k+1}=u_i^k-\frac{R_i(u^k)}{D_i(u^k)},\qquad z_i^{m+1}=\frac{b_i-\sum_{j<i}P_{ij}z_j^{m+1}-\sum_{j>i}P_{ij}z_j^m}{P_{ii}}.

二阶中，P 是按一阶残差组装的稀疏近似。每次预处理从 z=0 开始做三次 GS，形成一个固定线性映射 B；GMRES 对 A B 构造 Krylov 子空间，得到修正 Δu=B y。A v 由完整二阶前向计算给出。即使 P 忽略重构邻点，收敛时检查的仍是完整系统 AΔu+R，而不是近似系统 PΔu+R。

For second order, P is the sparse first-order approximate Jacobian. Each preconditioner application starts at z=0 and performs three GS sweeps, defining a fixed linear map B. GMRES builds its Krylov space for A B and forms Δu=B y. Exact A v comes from the full second-order tangent. Although P omits reconstruction neighbours, convergence checks AΔu+R, not PΔu+R.

if order == 1:
    R, D = residual_and_diagonal(u_old)
    u_new[:] = u_old[:] - R[:] / D[:]
else:
    A(v) = exact_residual_jvp(u,v)
    B(r) = three_GS_sweeps(first_order_P,r,start=0)
    du = right_preconditioned_GMRES(A,-R,B)
    alpha = backtrack_until_positive_and_residual_decreases()
    u_new = u_old + alpha*du
第 6 节
Section 6

目标函数

The objective function

类似阻力的表面积分

A drag-like surface integral

取类似阻力的表面积分作为目标函数 L：把物面上的“压力” 12u2 投影到来流方向再沿物面积分——这正是气动优化里阻力那一类量：

Take a drag-like surface integral as the objective L: project the "pressure" 12u2 on the body onto the free-stream direction and integrate along the surface — precisely the family of quantities drag belongs to in aerodynamic optimisation:

L=Σ壁面12uL2(n·e),e=β|β|=(0.894, 0.447).
L=Σwall12uL2(n·e),e=β|β|=(0.894, 0.447).

这里的物面是无粘壁面。L 只依赖壁面上的状态，所以 g=(∂L/∂u)T 只在壁面节点上非零（1–8 号）。后面会看到，伴随解 ψ 却遍布整个流场：物面上的量通过一连串面通量受到上游的影响。

The body here is an inviscid wall. L depends only on the states at the wall, so g=(∂L/∂u)T is non-zero only on the wall nodes themselves, nodes 1–8. As will be seen, the adjoint solution ψ nevertheless spreads over the whole field: quantities on the body are influenced from upstream through a chain of face fluxes.

为什么要投影到来流方向。n·e 是有正负的：迎风面与背风面的贡献方向相反。因为物体封闭，Σ壁面n=0，所以均匀流场给出的 L 恒等于零——阻力完全来自物面上 u 的不均匀分布。这正是它比“载荷大小之和 Σ12u2|n|”更像真实气动量的地方。 把每个壁面半面的贡献和它们的总和画了出来。

Why project onto the free-stream direction. n·e has a sign: the windward and leeward contributions point opposite ways. Because the body is closed, Σwalln=0, so a uniform field gives L≡0 — the drag comes entirely from the non-uniform distribution of u over the body. That is exactly what makes it more like a real aerodynamic quantity than "the sum of load magnitudes Σ12u2|n|". draws the contribution of every wall half-face and their sum.

Added: smooth characteristic-boundary model

目标函数：内边界上的数学泛函

Objective: a mathematical inner-boundary functional

保留原来的有方向内边界积分形式，但不再解释为不可穿透物面的真实受力。令 e=β/|β|，目标为内边界上 u²/2 的投影积分。一阶取原来的控制体值，二阶使用边界重构和同样的 Gauss 积分；目标的导数也必须穿过重构。

Keep the original direction-projected inner-boundary integral, but no longer interpret it as a physical force on an impermeable body. With e=β/|β|, integrate u²/2 against e·n. First order uses the original control-volume value; second order uses boundary reconstruction and the same Gauss quadrature. Objective derivatives must include reconstruction.

J=∫Γinner12u2e⋅n ds,Jh=∑f∈Γinner∑qwq2(uf,q−)2e⋅nf.J=\int_{\Gamma_{inner}}\frac12u^2\boldsymbol e\cdot\boldsymbol n\,ds,\qquad J_h=\sum_{f\in\Gamma_{inner}}\sum_q\frac{w_q}{2}(u_{f,q}^-)^2\boldsymbol e\cdot\boldsymbol n_f.

由于解析场在孔洞内部也满足散度为零，其整个封闭内边界积分恰好为零。粗网格的 J_h 一般不为零，因此本例也可观察离散积分及其设计梯度如何趋近零。这一退化的连续目标不是优化算例的有效性能指标；在这里用于检验实际离散求导链。

The analytic field is divergence-free even inside the hole, so the closed inner-boundary integral is exactly zero. A coarse-grid J_h generally is not zero; its value and design derivatives can be studied as discretisation errors. This degenerate continuous objective is not a useful optimisation performance metric; here it tests the actual discrete differentiation chain.

从离散目标得到伴随右端

From a discrete objective to the adjoint right-hand side

不能只对连续积分写一个形式导数就结束。先确定代码实际使用的求积点、权重、重构状态及边界值，再对这个标量表达式求导。以平方跟踪目标为例，以下是一般求积链式法则；非跟踪目标使用本节给出的实际目标表达式。

A formal derivative of a continuous integral is not enough. First identify the quadrature points, weights, reconstructed states and boundary values actually used by the code, then differentiate that scalar expression. For a squared tracking objective the quadrature chain rule is as follows; non-tracking objectives use the actual expression given in this section.

Jh=12∑qωq(a) eq2,eq=θq(Uh,a)−θq∗(a),δJh=∑q[ωqeq(δθq−δθq∗)+12eq2δωq].J_h=\frac12\sum_q\omega_q(a)\,e_q^2,\quad e_q=\theta_q(\mathbf U_h,a)-\theta_q^*(a),\qquad \delta J_h=\sum_q\left[\omega_q e_q(\delta\theta_q-\delta\theta_q^*)+\frac12 e_q^2\delta\omega_q\right].

求 j_U 时固定所有设计变量；求 j_a 时固定全部离散状态槽位。固定解析目标函数并不一定意味着移动网格上的目标采样值不变：如果采样点随设计移动，还要保留该位置依赖。固定网格及固定采样值时，相应项才为零。目标中的体积权重已经进入 j_U，不应在伴随右端再乘一次体积。

Hold every design variable fixed for j_U, and every stored state entry fixed for j_a. A fixed analytic target function need not have fixed samples on a moving mesh: its evaluation locations may depend on the design. The corresponding terms vanish only when the mesh and samples are fixed. Objective volume weights already enter j_U and must not be multiplied into the adjoint right-hand side again.

第 7 节
Section 7

matrix-free 前向：计算 Av

Matrix-free forward mode: computing Av

为什么需要 ATw：梯度

Why ATw is needed: the gradient

设计变量 X∈ℝM 取网格坐标（本页取全部节点坐标，外形由其中壁面节点那部分决定）。对 R(u(X),X)=0 用链式法则得 Adu/dX=−∂R/∂X，于是

The design variables X∈ℝM are the mesh coordinates (all node coordinates on this page; the shape is the wall node part of them). Applying the chain rule to R(u(X),X)=0 gives Adu/dX=−∂R/∂X, hence

dLdX=∂L∂X−∂L∂u1×NA−1N×N∂R∂XN×M.

先算右边的乘积，要对每个设计变量各解一次线性方程组（M 次）；先算左边的乘积，只需解一次伴随方程 ATψ=−(∂L/∂u)T，然后

Evaluate the right-hand pair first and one linear system has to be solved per design variable (M of them); evaluate the left-hand pair first and only a single adjoint equation ATψ=−(∂L/∂u)T is needed, after which

dLdX=∂L∂X+ψT∂R∂X.

形状优化中 M 常达数千，而伴随的求解次数始终是 1（每个目标函数一次）。

In shape optimisation M often runs to thousands, while the adjoint always needs exactly one solve (one per objective).

把这条乘积链画出来就一目了然（）：同一串矩阵，只是加括号的方式不同。先乘右边那一对，得到的中间量有 M 列，于是要解 M 次；先乘左边那一对，得到的中间量只有一行，于是只解一次——这一行就是 −ψT。

Drawing the product chain makes it obvious (): the same string of matrices, bracketed two different ways. Multiply the right-hand pair first and the intermediate has M columns, so it costs M solves; multiply the left-hand pair first and the intermediate is a single row, so it costs one — and that row is −ψT.

“伴随”就是转置

"Adjoint" means transpose

对任意矩阵 A 和向量 v,w，恒有

For any matrix A and vectors v,w, it always holds that

⟨w,Av⟩=wTAv=(ATw)Tv=⟨ATw,v⟩.

满足这一关系的算子称为伴随算子，对实矩阵就是转置。前向乘积把“状态上的扰动”映射成“残差的变化”；伴随乘积方向相反，把“残差上的权重”映射成“状态上的敏感度”。

An operator satisfying this relation is called the adjoint; for a real matrix it is the transpose. The forward product maps "a perturbation of the state" to "the change in the residual"; the adjoint product runs the other way, mapping "a weight on the residual" to "a sensitivity on the state".

什么是 matrix-free

What matrix-free means

第 7、8 两节要回答的就是一个问题：怎样在不形成矩阵的情况下计算这两个乘积。

Sections 7 and 8 answer a single question: how to compute these two products without forming the matrix.

v↦Av前向乘积w↦ATw伴随乘积
v↦Avforward productw↦ATwadjoint product

实际网格的 N 可达 105–108。GMRES 等 Krylov 迭代解法从不读取单个矩阵元素，只需要“给一个向量、返回乘积”的函数（Jacobi 另外只需要对角元）。matrix-free 就是不形成、不存储 A，直接写函数 residual_d(u, v) 返回 Av、residual_b(u, w) 返回 ATw。

On a real mesh N can reach 105–108. Krylov solvers such as GMRES never read an individual matrix entry; all they need is a function that takes a vector and returns the product (Jacobi needs only the diagonal besides). matrix-free means exactly that: never form or store A, and instead write residual_d(u, v) returning Av and residual_b(u, w) returning ATw.

前向容易，伴随难。Av 可以用一次扰动近似：Av≈[R(u+δv)−R(u)]/δ。ATw 没有这样的公式，必须把残差计算反过来求导。

Forward is easy, adjoint is not. Av can be approximated with a single perturbation: Av≈[R(u+δv)−R(u)]/δ. There is no such formula for ATw — the residual computation has to be differentiated in reverse.

对一维通量求导

Differentiating the one-dimensional flux

h=H(uL,uR) 只有两个输入。两侧状态有微小扰动 vL、vR 时，由链式法则

h=H(uL,uR) has only two inputs. When the two states carry small perturbations vL and vR, the chain rule gives

hd=cLvL+cRvR,cL=12vnuL+ε|n|,cR=12vnuR−ε|n|.

cL、cR 是局部导数，在冻结状态 u* 处取值。下表四种面的差别只体现在这两个系数上：

cL and cR are the local derivatives, evaluated at the frozen state u*. The four kinds of face below differ only in these two coefficients:

组装：与残差完全相同的边循环

Assembly: exactly the same edge loop as the residual

把 residual 里的“状态”换成“扰动”、flux 换成 flux_d，其余一行不改：收集两端扰动，计算 hd，按同样的符号分发（）。

Replace "state" by "perturbation" in residual, and flux by flux_d; not one other line changes. Gather the perturbations at the two ends, compute hd, scatter it with the same signs ().

的默认种子是 v=ei（只扰动一个内部节点）。播放时注意：只有该节点的那些对偶面得到非零的 hd，最后只有它和它的邻居非零——这正是 A 的相应一列。点击网格中的控制体可以逐个修改种子（0 → 1 → −1 → 0）。

The default seed in is v=ei (perturbing a single interior node). Watch as it plays: only the dual faces of that node pick up a non-zero hd, and at the end only the node itself and its neighbours are non-zero — which is precisely the corresponding column of A. Click a control volume in the mesh to cycle its seed entry (0 → 1 → −1 → 0).

为什么这就是 Av

Why this is exactly Av

每个面的计算是线性的：hd=cLvL+cRvR，再以 +,− 分发到 i,j。所以一个内部对偶面对 A 的贡献只落在第 i,j 行、第 i,j 列交叉处的 2×2 块上（边界半面只贡献 Aii，无粘壁面半面什么也不贡献）：

The computation on each face is linear: hd=cLvL+cRvR, then scattered to i,j with +,−. So the contribution of one interior dual face to A falls only on the 2×2 block where rows i,j meet columns i,j (a boundary half-face contributes only Aii, and an inviscid wall half-face contributes nothing at all):

​AiiAijAjiAjj+=​cLcR−cL−cR.

这一点在 的“矩阵视图”里可以直接看到：播放时，当前对偶面写入的块会被高亮（内部对偶面是 2×2 块，远场半面只有对角元，无粘壁面半面什么也不写），右边两列分别是显式矩阵乘积与边循环的累加结果——循环走完，两列完全相同。

This is visible directly in the "matrix view" of : as it plays, the block written by the current dual face is highlighted (a 2×2 block for an interior dual face, just the diagonal entry for a far-field half-face, nothing at all for an inviscid wall half-face), and the two columns on the right hold the explicit matrix product and the running total of the edge loop — once the loop has finished, the two columns agree exactly.

前向：通量之前还有重构导数

Tangent: differentiate reconstruction before flux

给状态方向 v 与几何／入流参数方向 δp，逐个标量操作应用链式法则。固定网格时，最小二乘梯度对 u 是线性的；几何变化时，M 本身也会改变。漏掉 δM 项会使状态点积检验仍然通过，却使形状梯度错误。

Given state direction v and geometry/inflow direction δp, apply the chain rule to every scalar operation. The least-squares gradient is linear in u for fixed geometry, but M changes under geometry perturbations. Omitting δM may still pass a state transpose test while corrupting shape gradients.

δ∇hui=Mi−1(δbi−δMi∇hui),δuf=δui+δ∇hui⋅(xf−xi)+∇hui⋅(δxf−δxi).\delta\nabla_hu_i=M_i^{-1}(\delta b_i-\delta M_i\nabla_hu_i),\qquad\delta u_f=\delta u_i+\delta\nabla_hu_i\cdot(x_f-x_i)+\nabla_hu_i\cdot(\delta x_f-\delta x_i).
cL=12(β⋅n)u−+εℓ,cR=12(β⋅n)u+−εℓ,δH=cLδu−+cRδu++Hn⋅δn.c_L=\tfrac12(\boldsymbol\beta\cdot\boldsymbol n)u^-+\varepsilon\ell,\quad c_R=\tfrac12(\boldsymbol\beta\cdot\boldsymbol n)u^+-\varepsilon\ell,\quad\delta H=c_L\delta u^-+c_R\delta u^++H_n\cdot\delta n.

differentiate M and b; dgrad = solve(M, db-dM*grad)
differentiate reconstructed traces and inflow g(xq)
dH = chain_rule(flux)
dR[L] += dH; dR[R] -= dH
δwij=−2dij⋅δdij(dij⋅dij)2,δMi=∑j[δwijdijdijT+wij(δdijdijT+dijδdijT)].\delta w_{ij}=-2\frac{d_{ij}\cdot\delta d_{ij}}{(d_{ij}\cdot d_{ij})^2},\quad\delta M_i=\sum_j\left[\delta w_{ij}d_{ij}d_{ij}^T+w_{ij}(\delta d_{ij}d_{ij}^T+d_{ij}\delta d_{ij}^T)\right].
δbi=∑j[(δwijdij+wijδdij)(uj−ui)+wijdij(δuj−δui)].\delta b_i=\sum_j\left[(\delta w_{ij}d_{ij}+w_{ij}\delta d_{ij})(u_j-u_i)+w_{ij}d_{ij}(\delta u_j-\delta u_i)\right].

先解出原梯度 g=M⁻¹b，再对 M g=b 求导：M δg=δb−δM g。这样不用显式推导逆矩阵的每个元素，也清楚地看到几何项来自哪里。固定网格令 δd=δw=δM=0；几何方向则不能省略这些项。面板用固定示例方向 v_i=sin(i+1) 展示逐面累加，下一节求解面板再计算真正的参数敏感度。

First solve g=M⁻¹b, then differentiate M g=b to obtain M δg=δb−δM g. This exposes the geometry terms without separately differentiating every inverse entry. Fixed-grid directions set δd=δw=δM=0; shape directions cannot. The face player uses the sample direction v_i=sin(i+1); the tangent-solve panel later computes actual parameter sensitivities.

局部导数怎样组成全局 Jacobian

How local derivatives form the global Jacobian

固定网格和当前可微分支，把一个面的所有输入记为 z_f；它包括重构状态以及该通量需要的梯度、几何和边界数据。令 T_f、K_f 分别是 z_f 对存储状态和设计参数的导数，H_z 是局部通量 Jacobian。于是每个残差行的导数按同一个有向面关联矩阵 B 装配。这里的求和包括相应的边界通量映射；强约束行另按第 8 节替换。

At fixed mesh and differentiable branch, let z_f collect all face inputs: reconstructed states and the gradients, geometry and boundary data required by the flux. Let T_f and K_f be derivatives of z_f with respect to stored states and design parameters, and H_z the local flux Jacobian. Assemble each residual derivative with the same oriented face incidence B. Include the appropriate boundary flux maps in this sum; strong constraint rows are replaced as in Section 8.

δzf=Tfv+Kfd,δHf=Hz,fδzf,(δRraw)i=∑fBifδHf−δSi,\delta z_f=T_fv+K_fd,\quad\delta H_f=H_{z,f}\delta z_f,\quad (\delta R_{raw})_i=\sum_fB_{if}\delta H_f-\delta S_i,
(Araw)ij=∑fBifHz,f(Tf)j−∂Si∂Uj,(Craw)ik=∑fBifHz,f(Kf)k−∂Si∂ak.(A_{raw})_{ij}=\sum_fB_{if}H_{z,f}(T_f)_j-\frac{\partial S_i}{\partial U_j},\qquad (C_{raw})_{ik}=\sum_fB_{if}H_{z,f}(K_f)_k-\frac{\partial S_i}{\partial a_k}.

无体源项时 S_i=0。面长度、面积和法向量的设计依赖属于 z_f，不能只对状态求导。二阶重构使 T_f 连接更多邻居，因此精确 Jacobian 的模板变宽；matrix-free 仍只需依次执行这些局部乘积，不必存储全局矩阵。

Set S_i=0 when there is no volume source. Design-dependent face lengths, areas and normals belong in z_f; state differentiation alone is insufficient. Second-order reconstruction connects T_f to more neighbours and widens the exact Jacobian stencil. Matrix-free evaluation performs these local products without storing the global matrix.

第 8 节
Section 8

matrix-free 伴随：计算 ATw

Matrix-free adjoint mode: computing ATw

把一维通量反过来

Reversing the one-dimensional flux

前向的一维通量是“两个输入、一个输出”：(vL,vR)↦hd=cLvL+cRvR。它的转置是“一个输入、两个输出”：给面上的权重 hb，返回

The forward one-dimensional flux is "two inputs, one output": (vL,vR)↦hd=cLvL+cRvR. Its transpose is "one input, two outputs": given a weight hb on the face, it returns

(uL,b,uR,b)=(cLhb,cRhb).

整个边循环也按同样的规则倒过来：原来写 r[i] 的地方现在读 w[i]，原来读 u[i] 的地方现在写 y[i]。注意符号：原来是 r[i]+=h、r[j]−=h，转置后就是 hb=w[i]−w[j]；两个分发则都是加。

The whole edge loop reverses by the same rule: where it used to write r[i] it now reads w[i], and where it used to read u[i] it now writes y[i]. Mind the signs: what was r[i]+=h and r[j]−=h becomes hb=w[i]−w[j] after transposing, while both scatters are additions.

在里对比第 7 节：底部数组的箭头方向反过来了——输入权重 w 在下面（残差一侧），结果 y 在上面（状态一侧）。这就是“转置”在数据流上的样子。无粘壁面半面上 cL=0，所以它在伴随里同样什么都不贡献。

Compare with Section 7: the arrows on the bottom arrays have reversed — the input weights w are below (the residual side) and the result y above (the state side). That is what "transpose" looks like as data flow. On an inviscid wall half-face cL=0, so it contributes nothing in the adjoint either.

三个函数逐行对照

The three functions, line by line

点积测试

The dot-product test

怎样确认 residual_b 写对了？利用 ⟨w,Av⟩=⟨ATw,v⟩：任取两个向量，分别调用前向和伴随函数，比较两个内积。只要有一个系数或符号写错，随机向量几乎必然让两者不相等（）。

How do you confirm that residual_b is written correctly? Use ⟨w,Av⟩=⟨ATw,v⟩: take any two vectors, call the forward and the adjoint function, and compare the two inner products. If even one coefficient or sign is wrong, random vectors will almost certainly make the two disagree ().

Each click generates two fresh random vectors
新增：光滑特征边界模型
Added: smooth characteristic-boundary model

伴随：反向传播并累加到整个重构邻域

Adjoint: reverse and accumulate through the reconstruction stencil

内部面通量的反向种子仍是 w_L−w_R。新增的是面状态向梯度和中心值反传，再把梯度的伴随传给所有最小二乘邻点。共享节点、中心和几何量上的贡献都要累加。面板逐面分解完整反向贡献，包括该面的重构链；它不是仅把旧通量的两个局部导数调换位置。

An internal face still receives reverse seed w_L−w_R. Trace adjoints now pass to gradients and centre values, then to all least-squares neighbours. Accumulate every path to shared nodes, centres and geometry. The panel decomposes the complete reverse contribution of each face, including reconstruction; it does not merely swap two old flux derivatives.

H‾=wL−wR,u‾i+=u‾f,∇hui‾+=(xf−xi)u‾f,wTAv=vTATw.\overline H=w_L-w_R,\quad\overline u_i\mathrel{+}=\overline u_f,\quad\overline{\nabla_hu_i}\mathrel{+}=(x_f-x_i)\overline u_f,\quad w^TAv=v^TA^Tw.
for face in reverse order:
    Hbar = w[L] - w[R]
    reverse flux, boundary closure and reconstructed traces
    reverse the least-squares dependency for this contribution
    accumulate into all state and coordinate inputs
# Full operator uses the reverse of the same scalar graph.

反向经过线性重构时，一份面迹种子分别累加到中心状态、梯度和重构偏移。反向经过 g=M⁻¹b 时先解 Mᵀ b̄=ḡ，再得到 M̄=−b̄gᵀ。之后沿 M 和 b 的求和定义反传到每个邻点、权重和坐标。同一个邻点可能被多个面访问，所以必须使用 +=。

Reverse a reconstructed trace by accumulating its seed into the centre state, gradient and offset. Reversing g=M⁻¹b first solves Mᵀ b̄=ḡ and then gives M̄=−b̄gᵀ. Reverse the sums defining M and b into every neighbour, weight and coordinate. Multiple faces share neighbours, so contributions must use +=.

bˉi=Mi−Tgˉi,Mˉi=−bˉigiT,uˉj+=wijdij⋅bˉi,uˉi−=wijdij⋅bˉi.\bar b_i=M_i^{-T}\bar g_i,\qquad\bar M_i=-\bar b_i g_i^T,\qquad\bar u_j\mathrel{+}=w_{ij}d_{ij}\cdot\bar b_i,\quad\bar u_i\mathrel{-}=w_{ij}d_{ij}\cdot\bar b_i.

上式最后两项只展示固定几何时 b 的状态路径；完整形状反向还包括 M、权重、偏移和边界函数。实际代码用标量计算图记录加减乘除、开方与正弦，再按相反顺序执行其解析局部导数。它没有保存全局 A 的所有元素，也没有通过有限差分构造 Aᵀw。

The last two terms show only the state path through b at fixed geometry. Full shape reversal includes M, weights, offsets and boundary data. The implementation records scalar arithmetic, square roots and sine on a tape and reverses their analytic local derivatives. It neither stores every entry of global A nor constructs Aᵀw by finite differences.

为什么反向累加给出矩阵转置

Why reverse accumulation gives the matrix transpose

把所有残差和状态分量展平后，下面只是交换两个有限求和的次序。w 是任意残差种子，尚未求解伴随方程；只有选择满足第 10 节线性方程的 w=ψ_h，才得到该目标对应的离散伴随解。

After flattening all residual and state components, the following simply exchanges two finite sums. The residual seed w is arbitrary and has not solved an adjoint equation. Only w=ψ_h satisfying Section 10 gives the discrete adjoint solution for the chosen objective.

wT(Ahv)=∑r=1nu∑j=1nuwr∂Rh,r∂Uh,jvj=∑j=1nuvj(∑r=1nu∂Rh,r∂Uh,jwr)=vT(AhTw).w^T(A_hv)=\sum_{r=1}^{n_u}\sum_{j=1}^{n_u}w_r\frac{\partial R_{h,r}}{\partial U_{h,j}}v_j=\sum_{j=1}^{n_u}v_j\left(\sum_{r=1}^{n_u}\frac{\partial R_{h,r}}{\partial U_{h,j}}w_r\right)=v^T(A_h^Tw).

内部面通量向左加、向右减，所以先把这两条路径合并成通量种子；之后按通量、重构、原始状态的相反依赖顺序传播。反向赋值中的 += 很重要：同一状态会被多个面和多个求积点读取。这里没有分部积分，也没有另行猜测连续伴随边界条件。

An interior flux is added on the left and subtracted on the right, so combine those two paths into its seed before reversing fluxes, reconstruction and stored states. The += is essential because multiple faces and quadrature points read the same state. There is no integration by parts and no separately guessed continuous adjoint boundary condition.

RL+=Hf, RR−=Hf⟹H‾f=wL−wR,Uf=∑jWfjUj⟹U‾j+=WfjTU‾f.R_L\mathrel{+}=H_f,\ R_R\mathrel{-}=H_f\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\overline H_f=w_L-w_R,\qquad U_f=\sum_jW_{fj}U_j\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\overline U_j\mathrel{+}=W_{fj}^T\overline U_f.

若最后把某些守恒行替换为边界约束，令 M_bc 为保留行的对角掩码，E_bc 把约束向量 c 放入被替换行。它们在固定网格拓扑上是常矩阵。完整转置必须包含约束的 Jacobian，而不是简单地把边界伴随设为零。没有强替换行时 M_bc=I，约束项为空；弱边界映射仍包含在 R_raw 内。

For overwritten balance rows, let M_bc mask the retained rows and E_bc insert the constraint vector c into the replaced rows. Both are constant for fixed topology. The transpose includes the constraint Jacobian; it does not simply zero boundary adjoints. Without row replacement, M_bc=I and the constraint term is empty; weak boundary maps remain inside R_raw.

Rh=MbcRraw+Ebcc,Ah=MbcAraw+EbccU,AhTw=ArawTMbcTw+cUTEbcTw.R_h=M_{bc}R_{raw}+E_{bc}c,\quad A_h=M_{bc}A_{raw}+E_{bc}c_U,\quad A_h^Tw=A_{raw}^TM_{bc}^Tw+c_U^TE_{bc}^Tw.
第 9 节
Section 9

前向求解：切线方程

The forward solve: the tangent equation

第 7 节只算了乘积 Av。前向模式真正要解的是切线方程：选一个输入 α，对 R(u(α),α)=0 求导，u 随 α 的变化率 v=du/dα 满足

Section 7 only computed the product Av. What forward mode actually has to solve is the tangent equation: pick one input α and differentiate R(u(α),α)=0 with respect to it; the rate v=du/dα at which u follows α satisfies

Av=−f,f=∂R∂α

这里取远场来流值 α=u∞。只有远场入流半面见到它（作为通量的右状态），所以 f=∂R/∂u∞ 就是这些面上通量对右槽位的导数，写进各自的左节点，共 5 个非零分量。

Here take the far-field free-stream value, α=u∞. Only the far-field inflow half-faces see it, as the right state of their flux, so f=∂R/∂u∞ is the derivative of those fluxes with respect to their right slot, written into their left nodes: 5 non-zero entries.

与 primal 同一个 Jacobi 迭代

The Jacobi iteration of the primal

切线方程是线性的，用第 5 节那个 Jacobi 迭代、同一个 D 求解：

The tangent equation is linear, and it is solved by the Jacobi iteration of Section 5, with the same D:

v←v−D−1(Av+f)

每一轮只调用一次与矩阵有关的函数：第 7 节的 residual_d，算出 Av。D 是第 5 节的 diagonal 在 u* 处的值。除此之外，矩阵既不形成，也不分解：这就是 matrix-free 的前向求解。

Each sweep calls just one matrix-related function: residual_d of Section 7, which computes Av. D is what diagonal of Section 5 returns at u*. Beyond that the matrix is neither formed nor factorised: this is the forward solve, matrix-free.

收敛：与 primal 同一个速率

Convergence: at the primal's rate

在解附近，primal 迭代的误差每一轮乘以 I−D−1A，切线迭代的误差乘的正是同一个矩阵。所以 primal 一过它非线性的起始阶段，两条收敛曲线就以同一个速率下降，这个速率就是谱半径 0.797：实测 k=60 到 100 之间，两者每轮都缩小 0.7971 倍。起点不同：primal 从 u≡1 出发，切线从 v=0 出发，初始残差就是 f。 逐轮播放切线迭代：上面一行按面播放本轮内部的 residual_d 边循环（80 个面：48 个对偶面 + 32 个边界半面，最后一步是 Jacobi 更新），下面一行按轮播放，看切线解 v 如何从远场入流边界向下游铺开。切线迭代在 k=133 时降到判据 10−13 以下，从 k=165 起落在舍入误差平台上。

Near the solution the primal iteration multiplies its error every sweep by I−D−1A, and the tangent iteration multiplies its error by exactly the same matrix. So once the primal is past its nonlinear start, the two convergence curves fall at the same rate, the spectral radius 0.797: measured between k=60 and 100, both shrink by 0.7971 per sweep. They start from different places: the primal from u≡1, the tangent from v=0, its first residual being f. plays the tangent iteration: the upper row runs face by face through the residual_d edge loop inside one sweep (80 faces: 48 dual faces plus 32 boundary half-faces, the last step being the Jacobi update), while the lower row runs sweep by sweep, showing how the tangent solution v spreads downstream from the far-field inflow boundary. The tangent iteration drops below the 10−13 criterion at k=133 and is on its round-off floor from k=165 on.

结果：dL/du∞

The result: dL/du∞

L 不直接依赖 u∞，所以

L does not depend on u∞ directly, so

dLdu∞=gTv,g=(∂L∂u)T

本算例是 1.95162064261909；在 u∞±10−6 各重解一次 primal 的中心差分与它的相对差是 1.8×10−10。一次切线求解只回答一个输入：要得到对第 11 节 48 个坐标的导数，前向那一路要解 48 次。下一节从另一头走，一次伴随求解就得到全部。

Here it comes to 1.95162064261909; a central difference that re-solves the primal at u∞±10−6 differs from it by 1.8×10−10 (relative). One tangent solve answers one input: for the derivatives with respect to the 48 coordinates of Section 11, the forward route has to solve 48 times. The next section goes from the other end, where one adjoint solve gives them all.

新增：光滑特征边界模型
Added: smooth characteristic-boundary model

前向方程：一个设计方向一次求解

Tangent equation: one solve per design direction

对收敛方程 R(u(p),p)=0 求导，得到 A u̇=−R_p ṗ。这里不是给一个任意 v 做一次算子乘积，而是求出整个敏感度场。求解后用 J_u u̇+J_p ṗ 与伴随梯度的同一分量比较。

Differentiating R(u(p),p)=0 gives A u̇=−R_p ṗ. This solves a sensitivity field rather than applying the tangent once to an arbitrary v. Compare J_u u̇+J_p ṗ with the corresponding adjoint gradient component.

Au˙=−Rpp˙,J˙=Juu˙+Jpp˙.A\dot u=-R_p\dot p,\qquad\dot J=J_u\dot u+J_p\dot p.

把隐函数求导展开成可求解的系统

Expand implicit differentiation into a solvable system

设原始残差已经收敛，且当前光滑分支上的 A_h 非奇异。取一个参数方向 d，令 a(ε)=a+εd，v=dU_h(a+εd)/dε|₀。对每一个残差分量逐项求导，零残差的导数仍为零：

Assume the primal residual is converged and A_h is nonsingular on the current smooth branch. Choose a parameter direction d, set a(ε)=a+εd and v=dU_h(a+εd)/dε|₀. Differentiate each residual component: the derivative of a zero residual is zero.

0=∑j∂Rh,r∂Uh,jvj+∑k∂Rh,r∂akdk(1≤r≤nu)⟹Ahv=−Chd.0=\sum_j\frac{\partial R_{h,r}}{\partial U_{h,j}}v_j+\sum_k\frac{\partial R_{h,r}}{\partial a_k}d_k\quad(1\le r\le n_u)\quad\Longrightarrow\quad A_hv=-C_hd.
J^h(a)=Jh(Uh(a),a),DJ^h(a)[d]=jUTv+jaTd.\widehat J_h(a)=J_h(\mathbf U_h(a),a),\qquad D\widehat J_h(a)[d]=j_U^Tv+j_a^Td.

实现分三步：状态种子取零、参数种子取 d，得到 C_hd；用精确 A_h 的乘积求解 v；再把状态种子 v 和参数种子 d 同时传入目标求导。一次 Av 只是算子调用，不是求解 v。稳态导数的对象是收敛残差方程，不是 Newton/GS 的迭代次数。不可微 limiter 或分支切换处，以上普通导数需要另外讨论，不能无条件套用。

Implementation has three steps: zero the state seed and seed parameters with d to obtain C_hd; solve for v with exact A_h products; then differentiate the objective with both v and d. One Av is an operator application, not the solution v. The steady derivative concerns the converged residual equation, not the Newton/GS iteration count. At nondifferentiable limiters or branch changes these ordinary derivatives require separate treatment.

第 10 节
Section 10

伴随求解：伴随方程

The adjoint solve: the adjoint equation

伴随方程 ATψ=−g 的右端项 g=(∂L/∂u)T 只在壁面节点（1–8 号）上非零。它同样用第 5 节的 Jacobi 迭代、同一个 D 求解（AT 与 A 的对角元相同）：

The right-hand side of the adjoint equation ATψ=−g, with g=(∂L/∂u)T, is non-zero only on the wall nodes (1–8). It too is solved by the Jacobi iteration of Section 5, with the same D (AT has the diagonal of A):

ψ←ψ−D−1(ATψ+g)

与矩阵有关的唯一操作是一次第 8 节的 residual_b 调用。

The only matrix-related operation is one call to residual_b of Section 8.

同一个导数，从另一头算

The same derivative, from the other end

伴随解同样给出第 9 节的那个导数，不用再解任何方程：

The adjoint solution gives the derivative of Section 9 as well, with no further solve:

dLdu∞=ψTf=gTv

本算例两者的相对差是 3.4×10−16。一次伴随求解回答一个输出对所有输入的导数：同一个 ψ 也给出第 11 节对 48 个坐标的导数，那里前向那一路要解 48 次。

Here the two agree to 3.4×10−16 (relative). One adjoint solve answers the derivatives of one output with respect to every input: the same ψ also gives the derivatives with respect to the 48 coordinates of Section 11, where the forward route solves 48 times.

收敛：三条曲线同一个速率

Convergence: one rate for all three

伴随迭代的误差每一轮乘以 I−D−1AT，它是 I−AD−1 的转置，而

The adjoint iteration multiplies its error every sweep by I−D−1AT, the transpose of I−AD−1, and

AD−1=D(D−1A)D−1

与 primal、切线的 D−1A 相似。转置不改变特征值，所以三个迭代矩阵的谱完全相同：进入渐近阶段以后，primal、切线、伴随三条收敛曲线以同一个速率下降，这个速率就是谱半径 0.797。实测 k=60 到 100 之间，三条曲线每轮都缩小 0.7971 倍，四位有效数字相同。 把三条曲线画在一起，并逐轮播放伴随迭代：上面一行按面播放本轮内部的 residual_b 边循环（80 个面：48 个对偶面 + 32 个边界半面，最后一步是 Jacobi 更新），下面一行按轮播放，看伴随解 ψ 如何从物面向上游铺开，与第 9 节里切线解的走向正好相反。

is similar to the primal's and the tangent's D−1A. Transposition leaves eigenvalues unchanged, so the three iteration matrices have exactly the same spectrum: once in the asymptotic phase the primal, tangent and adjoint convergence curves fall at the same rate, the spectral radius 0.797. Measured between k=60 and 100, all three shrink by 0.7971 per sweep, the same to four digits. draws the three curves together and plays the adjoint iteration: the upper row runs face by face through the residual_b edge loop inside one sweep (80 faces: 48 dual faces plus 32 boundary half-faces, the last step being the Jacobi update), while the lower row runs sweep by sweep, showing how the adjoint solution ψ spreads upstream from the body surface, the opposite way to the tangent solution of Section 9.

D 不再是常数。若网格均匀、边界右状态都取常数，闭合性会使 Di=εΣ|n| 对所有内部控制体相同。这里不是这样：壁面半面完全不贡献，远场出流面的导数是 vnuL，再加上混合网格本身的不均匀性，所以 Di 逐节点不同——面板副标题里给出了最小值与最大值。

D is no longer constant. On a uniform mesh with a constant right state on every boundary, closure would make Di=εΣ|n| the same for every interior control volume. That is not the case here: wall half-faces contribute nothing at all, the derivative on a far-field outflow face is vnuL, and the hybrid mesh is itself non-uniform, so Di differs from node to node — the panel subtitle gives the smallest and the largest value.

演示：伴随方程的 Jacobi 迭代，三条收敛曲线
Demo: the Jacobi iteration of the adjoint equation, and the three convergence curves
壁面（g 所在）the wall (where g lives)
本轮内的边循环：0 = 开始，1–80 = 逐个面（48 个对偶面 + 32 个边界半面），81 = Jacobi 更新
The edge loop within this sweep: 0 = start, 1–80 = face by face (48 dual faces + 32 boundary half-faces), 81 = the Jacobi update
Jacobi 轮次 k
Jacobi sweep k

收敛到机器精度是什么样子。三个迭代都没有停在判据处，而是跑满 300 轮。primal、切线、伴随分别在 k=122、133、108 时降到判据 10−13 以下，但这时仍以每轮 0.797 倍的比例下降：判据只是约定的停止点，并不说明迭代已经走到头。它们按同一比例一直降到 10−16 附近，然后分别从 k=153、165、148 起落在舍入误差平台上：此后再也不超过这次运行最后三分之一里的最大值，三个平台都在 1.3×10−16 与 2.1×10−16 之间。曲线变平，才说明迭代已经收敛到机器精度。停在判据处的 ψ 与平台上的 ψ 相差 4.6×10−13。

What convergence to machine precision looks like. None of the three iterations stops at the criterion; each runs the full 300 sweeps. The primal, the tangent and the adjoint drop below the 10−13 criterion at k=122, 133 and 108, but there they are still falling by a factor of 0.797 per sweep: a criterion is an agreed place to stop, not a sign that the iteration has run its course. They keep falling at that rate down to about 10−16 and then settle onto their round-off floors from k=153, 165 and 148 on: from there they never again rise above the largest value of the run's last third, and the three floors all lie between 1.3×10−16 and 2.1×10−16. Only this flat tail shows that an iteration has converged to machine precision. The ψ at the criterion is 4.6×10−13 away from the ψ on the floor.

−ψi 表示“在节点 i 的控制体中加一个单位源项时 L 的变化率”。g 只在物面非零，ψ 却遍布上游节点：它们通过一串面通量影响物面上的载荷。

−ψi is "the rate of change of L when a unit source is added in the control volume of node i". g is non-zero only on the body surface, yet ψ spreads over the upstream nodes: they influence the load on the body through a chain of face fluxes.

新增：光滑特征边界模型
Added: smooth characteristic-boundary model

伴随方程：一次求解得到全部设计导数

Adjoint equation: one solve for every design derivative

取离散 Lagrangian ℒ=J+ψᵀR，则 Aᵀψ=−J_uᵀ。右端只取决于目标函数；求解一次即可用反向参数累加得到全部 48 个节点坐标及入流均值 a 的导数。一阶用原来的 Jacobi 转置系统迭代；二阶用精确 Aᵀ 与转置 GS 预处理的 GMRES。

With ℒ=J+ψᵀR, solve Aᵀψ=−J_uᵀ. One solve supplies derivatives of all 48 node coordinates and the inflow mean a through a reverse parameter accumulation. First order retains Jacobi iteration of the transposed system; second order uses exact Aᵀ and transposed-GS-preconditioned GMRES.

ATψ=−JuT,g=JpT+RpTψ.A^T\psi=-J_u^T,\qquad g=J_p^T+R_p^T\psi.

停止条件检查原系统真残差。二阶预处理逆序扫块，并转置整个固定次数的 GS 映射。没有把近似 Jacobian 的转置当作精确伴随算子。

Stopping tests use the true system residual. The second-order preconditioner reverses traversal and transposes the complete fixed-sweep GS map. The approximate Jacobian transpose is not substituted for the exact adjoint operator.

一阶 Jacobi 解转置系统时，对角仍是 D，但非对角乘积必须调用 Aᵀψ。二阶采用 Bᵀ 预处理 Aᵀ；GS 的更新顺序反转，且使用转置的系数。这里 B 表示三次扫描的整个映射，不能只转置一个局部通量系数就声称完成了预处理转置。面板显示每次迭代的 ψ 与真残差，收敛后的梯度由一次反向参数累加得到。

For first-order transposed Jacobi, D stays the same but the product must be Aᵀψ. Second order preconditions Aᵀ with Bᵀ: reverse the GS update order and transpose its coefficients. B denotes the complete three-sweep mapping; transposing a local flux derivative alone is insufficient. The player displays each ψ iterate and true residual; a single reverse parameter accumulation then gives all gradients.

从有限维 Lagrangian 逐步消去状态敏感度

Eliminate state sensitivity from a finite-dimensional Lagrangian

Lh(Uh,a,ψh)=Jh(Uh,a)+ψhTRh(Uh,a).\mathcal L_h(\mathbf U_h,a,\psi_h)=J_h(\mathbf U_h,a)+\psi_h^TR_h(\mathbf U_h,a).

在满足 R_h=0 的解上 ℒ_h=J_h。先把 ψ_h 固定，对 U_h 与 a 做方向求导，再按状态扰动和设计扰动收集系数。即使 ψ_h 随设计改变，额外的 δψ_hᵀR_h 项也在收敛解上为零。

At a feasible state R_h=0, ℒ_h=J_h. Hold ψ_h fixed while differentiating in U_h and a, then collect state and design directions. Even if ψ_h varies with design, the extra δψ_hᵀR_h term vanishes at the converged state.

δLh=jUTδUh+jaTδa+ψhT(AhδUh+Chδa)=(jU+AhTψh)TδUh+(ja+ChTψh)Tδa.\delta\mathcal L_h=j_U^T\delta\mathbf U_h+j_a^T\delta a+\psi_h^T(A_h\delta\mathbf U_h+C_h\delta a)=(j_U+A_h^T\psi_h)^T\delta\mathbf U_h+(j_a+C_h^T\psi_h)^T\delta a.

选择 ψ_h 使未知的状态敏感度前面的系数为零。于是一个目标只需求解一次伴随线性系统，再进行参数反传；总设计梯度是列向量 g_design。注意符号来自这里的加号约定，并不是因为“伴随一定带负号”。

Choose ψ_h to cancel the coefficient of the unknown state sensitivity. One objective then requires one adjoint solve followed by parameter reverse accumulation. The total design gradient g_design is a column. Its sign follows from the plus convention in this Lagrangian, not a universal negative sign for adjoints.

AhTψh=−jU,gdesign=∇aJ^h=ja+ChTψh,(gdesign)k=∂Jh∂ak+∑rψh,r∂Rh,r∂ak.\boxed{A_h^T\psi_h=-j_U},\qquad\boxed{g_{design}=\nabla_a\widehat J_h=j_a+C_h^T\psi_h},\qquad (g_{design})_k=\frac{\partial J_h}{\partial a_k}+\sum_r\psi_{h,r}\frac{\partial R_{h,r}}{\partial a_k}.

也可以直接检查与 tangent 的等价性：利用 A_hv=−C_hd，j_Uᵀv=−ψ_hᵀA_hv=ψ_hᵀC_hd，所以两条路线都得到 g_designᵀd。更换为 ℒ_h=J_h−λ_hᵀR_h 会得到 λ_h=−ψ_h，但这只是两个离散乘子的符号约定，不能据此认定连续场 λ(x) 与离散向量逐点相等。

Check equivalence with the tangent: A_hv=−C_hd gives j_Uᵀv=−ψ_hᵀA_hv=ψ_hᵀC_hd, so both routes give g_designᵀd. Changing to ℒ_h=J_h−λ_hᵀR_h yields λ_h=−ψ_h, but that relates two discrete sign conventions; it does not prove pointwise equality with a continuous field λ(x).

精确算子决定求解哪个方程；GS、GMRES 和 LU 决定如何求解。较便宜的一阶 Jacobian 可以用于迭代修正或预处理，不能替代二阶残差的精确转置。应监控真残差 rψ=A_hᵀψ_h+j_U。若其不为零，当前伴随与精确 tangent 的方向导数差为 −rψᵀv，因此只看迭代次数或预处理残差不够。

The exact operator determines the equation; GS, GMRES and LU determine how it is solved. A cheaper first-order Jacobian may supply corrections or preconditioning, but cannot replace the exact second-order residual transpose. Monitor the true residual rψ=A_hᵀψ_h+j_U. If it is nonzero, the current adjoint directional derivative minus the exact tangent derivative is −rψᵀv; an iteration count or preconditioned residual alone is insufficient.

第 11 节
Section 11

几何导数：dR/dX 与 dL/dX

Geometric derivatives: dR/dX and dL/dX

到这里为止，状态以外的输入只出现过远场来流 u∞（第 9、10 节）；第 7 节只把网格坐标当作动机提了一句。真正的外形优化要的是对网格坐标 X 的导数。本节把这条链路从头到尾推一遍，前向与伴随各走一次，并说明几何项究竟藏在哪里。

So far the only input besides the state has been the free-stream value u∞ (Sections 9 and 10); Section 7 named the mesh coordinates only as motivation. Real shape optimisation needs the derivative with respect to the mesh coordinates X. This section works that chain through from end to end, once forward and once adjoint, and shows where the geometric terms actually hide.

两条链路

The two routes

设计变量取全部节点坐标 X（算例 24 个节点、48 个分量）。状态由 R(u,X)=0 隐式决定，目标写成 L(u,X)——两者都显式依赖坐标：残差通过面法向，目标通过物面法向。全导数是

The design variables are all the node coordinates X (24 nodes in the test case, 48 components). The state is fixed implicitly by R(u,X)=0 and the objective is written L(u,X) — and both depend explicitly on the coordinates as well: the residual through the face normals, the objective through the wall normals. The total derivative is

dLdX=∂L∂X+∂L∂ududX,

其中 du/dX 不能随便取：把 R(u(X),X)=0 对 X 求导，得到约束

where du/dX is not free to choose: differentiating R(u(X),X)=0 with respect to X gives the constraint

AdudX+∂R∂X=0,A=∂R∂u.

消去 du/dX 有两条路，区别只在先解哪一个：

There are two routes to eliminating du/dX, differing only in which one is solved first:

  • 前向（tangent）：对每一个设计变量 Xk 解一次 Aφk=−∂R/∂Xk，再取 dL/dXk=∂L/∂Xk+gTφk（g=(∂L/∂u)T）。代价正比于设计变量个数。
  • Forward (tangent): for every design variable Xk, solve Aφk=−∂R/∂Xk once, then take dL/dXk=∂L/∂Xk+gTφk (with g=(∂L/∂u)T). The cost is proportional to the number of design variables.
  • 伴随（adjoint）：只解一次 ATψ=−g，然后所有分量一起出来。
  • Adjoint: solve ATψ=−g just once, and every component comes out together.
dLdX=∂L∂X+ψT∂R∂X.

算例里前向要解 48 次线性系统，伴随只解 1 次，两条路的结果相差 1.0e−10（前向那一路的 ∂R/∂X 同样由中心差分装配，所以这个量级由步长决定）；各自与“逐分量重新求解 primal”的中心差分对照是 3.8e−10 与 3.7e−10（量级 1.032）。这就是伴随方法的全部理由：代价与设计变量个数无关。

In the test case the forward route solves 48 linear systems and the adjoint only 1, and the two results differ by 1.0e−10 (the ∂R/∂X of the forward route is likewise assembled from central differences, so this level too is set by the step); each agrees with central differences that re-solve the primal for every component to 3.8e−10 and 3.7e−10 respectively (on a magnitude of 1.032). This is the whole reason for the adjoint method: its cost does not depend on the number of design variables.

这条链路和它的几何依赖范围，可以直接对照 来看。

This chain, and how far its geometric dependence reaches, can be read off directly from .

几何量怎么依赖坐标

How the geometric quantities depend on the coordinates

残差对 X 的依赖全部藏在对偶面法向里。第 1 节给过它的构造：一条内部边 (i,j) 的法向由相邻单元各贡献一段，

The dependence of the residual on X hides entirely in the dual-face normals. Section 1 gave the construction: the normal of an interior edge (i,j) is assembled from one segment contributed by each adjacent cell,

nij=Σt∋(i,j)±(dy,−dx),d=xc−m,m=12(xi+xj),

其中 xc 是单元中心（顶点平均）。于是移动一个节点会同时改变它所有相邻单元的中心，进而改变这些单元里几乎每一条对偶面的法向（个别面上两个相邻单元的贡献恰好抵消，见上面的 (b)）——格点格式的几何依赖比格心格式宽一圈，这是两种格式在几何导数上唯一的实质差别。

where xc is the cell centre (the average of its vertices). So moving one node changes the centres of all its adjacent cells at once, and with them the normal of almost every dual face in those cells (on a few faces the two adjacent cells' contributions cancel exactly — see (b) of above) — the geometric dependence of a node-centred scheme reaches one ring wider than a cell-centred one, and that is the only substantive difference between the two schemes in the geometric derivatives.

通量对法向的导数与格心版逐字相同：

The derivative of the flux with respect to the normal is word for word the same as in the cell-centred version:

∂h∂n=14(uL2+uR2)β−ε(uR−uL)n|n|.

差别只在怎么把 nb 送回节点。先把旋转转置掉，db=(−snb,y,snb,x)（s=±1 是该段的取向），再按 d=xc−m 分给两处：

The difference lies only in how nb is sent back to the nodes. First transpose the rotation away, db=(−snb,y,snb,x) (where s=±1 is the orientation of that segment), then distribute it to two places through d=xc−m:

x该单元每个顶点,b+=db|t|,xi,b,xj,b−=12db.
xeach vertex of that cell,b+=db|t|,xi,b,xj,b−=12db.

前一式来自 xc 是顶点平均（|t| 是该单元的顶点数，三角形 3、四边形 4），后一式来自 m 是边中点。边界半面简单得多，它就是格心版的一半：nbnd=12(yb−ya,−(xb−xa))，转置回去也只差一个 12。

The first expression comes from xc being the vertex average (|t| is the number of vertices of that cell, 3 for a triangle and 4 for a quadrilateral), the second from m being the edge midpoint. A boundary half-face is far simpler, being exactly half of the cell-centred version: nbnd=12(yb−ya,−(xb−xa)), and transposing it back differs only by that 12.

目标函数的显式项

The explicit term of the objective

L=Σ壁面12uL2(n·e) 同样显式依赖坐标，而且只在物面上：

L=Σwall12uL2(n·e) depends explicitly on the coordinates too, and only on the body surface:

∂L∂n=12uL2e.

投影之后它是一个常向量，比通量那一项还简单。无粘壁面上 h≡0，所以壁面对 ψT∂R/∂X 没有贡献，却对 ∂L/∂X 有贡献——两项在同一个边循环里累加，这也是 gradient(u, psi) 一次循环就能给出完整梯度的原因。

After projection it is a constant vector, simpler even than the flux term. On an inviscid wall h≡0, so the wall contributes nothing to ψT∂R/∂X while it does contribute to ∂L/∂X — the two terms accumulate in the same edge loop, which is why gradient(u, psi) delivers the complete gradient in a single pass.

两项可以分开验证。把种子取成 ψ=0：非壁面分支的 hb 全为零，只剩目标函数那一项，于是 gradient(u, 0) 就是 ∂L/∂X；再用 gradient(u, psi) 减掉它，剩下的正是 ψT∂R/∂X。两半分别与中心差分（u 冻结）对照：8.4e−11 与 1.0e−10。

The two terms can be verified separately. Take the seed ψ=0: every hb outside the wall branch vanishes and only the objective term is left, so gradient(u, 0) is ∂L/∂X; subtract it from gradient(u, psi) and what remains is exactly ψT∂R/∂X. The two halves agree with central differences (with u frozen) to 8.4e−11 and 1.0e−10.

转置关系照样成立

The transpose relation holds here too

几何算子也有前向与伴随两个方向，同样可以用点积测试卡住：

The geometric operator has a forward and an adjoint direction as well, and a dot-product test pins it down just the same:

⟨w,(∂R/∂X)δX⟩=⟨(∂R/∂X)Tw,δX⟩.

算例实测偏差 1.1e−10——这条链的前向方向是用中心差分逐列装配的（h=10−6），所以这个量级由差分步长决定，而不是转置本身；第 8 节状态空间的点积测试是纯解析的，偏差在 10−15 量级。注意 w 住在残差空间（24 维）、δX 住在坐标空间（48 维）——两个空间维数不同，转置关系依然成立：这正是“伴随”与“转置”是同一件事的又一次体现。

The measured deviation is 1.1e−10 — the forward direction of this chain is assembled column by column from central differences (h=10−6), so this level is set by the step and not by the transpose; the state-space dot-product test of Section 8 is purely analytic and sits at the 10−15 level. Note that w lives in the residual space (24 dimensions) and δX in the coordinate space (48 dimensions) — the two spaces have different dimensions and the transpose relation holds regardless: one more sign that "adjoint" and "transpose" are the same thing.

一条必然成立的结构性检查

A structural check that cannot fail

把整个网格刚体平移，所有法向都不变，因此 L 不变。于是梯度必须满足

Translate the whole mesh rigidly and no normal changes, so L does not change either. The gradient must therefore satisfy

ΣkdLdXk=0

（两个坐标分量各自求和为零）。这条与差分无关、与算例无关，纯粹由问题的平移不变性决定，是几何梯度最便宜的自检——不过它只查平移不变性：通量导数的符号即使写错，各分量之和照样为零。算例实测两个分量之和的最大绝对值为 7.4×10−16。

(each of the two coordinate components summing to zero on its own). This owes nothing to finite differences and nothing to this particular test case; it follows purely from the translational invariance of the problem, and it is the cheapest self-check a geometric gradient has, though it only tests translational invariance: even a sign error in the flux derivative still sums to zero. The measured largest absolute value of the two component sums is 7.4×10−16.

全部实测

Everything, measured
