真实求解器里还多一层。本页把所有节点坐标都当设计变量。真实外形优化的设计变量是物面参数（FFD 控制点、样条系数……），体网格由变形算法从物面推出：Xvol=G(Xsurf)。链式法则再接一段 ∂G/∂Xsurf：伴随方向就是把本节得到的 dL/dXvol 通过网格变形算法的转置送回物面。结构一点没变，只是多接一段——而且那一段同样要用点积测试单独验证。

A real solver has one more layer. This page treats every node coordinate as a design variable. In real shape optimisation the design variables are surface parameters (FFD control points, spline coefficients, …), and the volume mesh is produced from the surface by a deformation algorithm: Xvol=G(Xsurf). The chain rule then gains one more link, ∂G/∂Xsurf: in the adjoint direction the dL/dXvol obtained here is sent back to the surface through the transpose of the mesh-deformation algorithm. The structure does not change at all, there is simply one more link — and that link has to be verified separately, with a dot-product test of its own.

新增：光滑特征边界模型
Added: smooth characteristic-boundary model

几何导数：法向、长度、梯度与边界位置

Geometry derivatives: normals, lengths, gradients and boundary locations

节点位置变化同时改变边法向、面长、积分点、单元中心及最小二乘权重。二阶还有重构偏移与目标边界值的路径。入流数据是固定的空间函数 g(x,y)，因此移动入流面时不能冻结 g 的数值。所有这些依赖均在同一个计算图内解析求导，没有用差分近似形状梯度。

Moving nodes changes normals, lengths, quadrature locations, centres and least-squares weights. Second order adds reconstruction-offset and objective-trace paths. The inflow is a fixed spatial function g(x,y), so its sampled value changes when an inflow face moves. All paths are differentiated analytically in the same graph, without finite-difference shape derivatives.

δn=(δyb−δya,−δxb+δxa),δℓ=n⋅δn/ℓ,δg=0.2πcos⁡[π(y−0.5x)](δy−0.5δx)+δa.\delta n=(\delta y_b-\delta y_a,-\delta x_b+\delta x_a),\quad\delta\ell=n\cdot\delta n/\ell,\quad\delta g=0.2\pi\cos[\pi(y-0.5x)](\delta y-0.5\delta x)+\delta a.

导数只在当前连接关系、有效网格和入／出流符号不改变的邻域内解释。跨过 β·n=0 时边界分支会改变，不能把当前线性化外推到另一分支。

Derivatives apply locally while connectivity, mesh validity and inflow/outflow signs remain unchanged. Crossing β·n=0 changes a branch and requires a fresh linearisation.

第 12 节
Section 12

验证：dL/dX 对有限差分

Verification: dL/dX against finite differences

上一节把 dL/dX 推了出来：伴随只解一次线性系统，就拿到全部分量。这一节只做一件事——验证它是对的。

The previous section derived dL/dX: the adjoint solves one linear system and gets every component. This section does one thing only — check that it is right.

判据是最朴素的那个，逐个坐标分量做中心差分：

The criterion is the plainest one there is, a central difference taken coordinate by coordinate:

dLdXk≈L(Xk+h)−L(Xk−h)2h.

关键在于 L(Xk±h) 是完整的目标函数：每次都要把网格改形、重新解一次非线性 primal、再算目标。所以这里验证的是全导数——状态对几何的响应也算在内——而不是冻结状态的偏导数。代价也正因如此：中心差分每个分量两次扰动，一共 2M 次非线性求解，而伴随只用了一次线性求解。

What matters is that L(Xk±h) is the complete objective: every evaluation deforms the mesh, solves the nonlinear primal again, and only then computes the objective. So what is verified here is the total derivative — the response of the state to the geometry included — and not a partial derivative at a frozen state. That is also what it costs: two perturbations per component, 2M nonlinear solves in all, against the single linear solve of the adjoint.

还有省一半的做法——前向差分，只往一侧扰动：

There is also a way to halve that — a forward difference, perturbing to one side only:

dLdXk≈L(Xk+h)−L(X)h.

基准值 L(X) 全局只算一次，于是总共约 M 次非线性求解而不是 2M 次。代价是精度低一个档次：截断误差是 O(h) 而不是 O(h2)。两者的误差随步长怎么走， 底部可以逐个变量扫描出来。

The baseline L(X) is computed once for all, so the total is about M nonlinear solves rather than 2M. The price is one order of accuracy: the truncation error is O(h) instead of O(h2). The sweep at the foot of plots how the two errors run with the step size, one variable at a time.

里可以自己改差分步长 h，再按“用差分验证”重算。

In the step h can be set by hand and recomputed with "Verify by differences".

交互：形状梯度、差分验证与步长扫描
Interactive: the shape gradient, its difference check, and a step-size sweep
L = ；箭头是移动各节点时 L 增加最快的方向（壁面节点上的箭头就是外形设计方向）; the arrows show the direction in which L grows fastest as each node moves (on the wall nodes they are the shape design directions)
横轴是步长 h，纵轴是相对误差——差分结果与伴随结果之差，再除以该分量伴随梯度的绝对值，纵横都是对数。左半段由截断误差主导：h 每缩小十倍，前向降 10 倍（O(h)）、中心降 100 倍（O(h2)）。右半段由舍入误差主导，两者相同（都约 10 倍地涨），所以两条曲线并拢。两个圈是各自的最优步长：典型情况下前向落在 ϵ1/2 附近、中心落在 ϵ1/3 附近，中心能达到的最好精度通常高出两个数量级左右；具体数值随分量而变。之所以取相对误差，是因为 48 个分量的 dL/dX 相差三个多数量级（实测约 6.5e−4 到 1.0），只看绝对误差时，梯度小的分量会显得更准，而这与步长好坏无关。曲线是在浏览器里实跑出来的——换一个变量，最优步长往往跟着移动，这正是拿同一个 h 走遍所有分量靠不住的原因。
The horizontal axis is the step h and the vertical axis the relative error — the difference between the finite-difference and the adjoint result, divided by the magnitude of that component's own adjoint gradient — both logarithmic. The left half is dominated by truncation: for every tenfold reduction of h the forward scheme falls by 10 (O(h)) and the central scheme by 100 (O(h2)). The right half is dominated by round-off, identical for both (each rising about tenfold), so the two curves close together. The two rings mark the optimal step of each: typically the forward one lies near ϵ1/2 and the central one near ϵ1/3, and the best accuracy of the central scheme is usually around two orders of magnitude better; the exact figures vary from component to component. The error is relative because dL/dX varies by more than three orders of magnitude across the 48 components (measured: about 6.5e−4 to 1.0): on an absolute axis a component with a small gradient looks more accurate for reasons that have nothing to do with the step. The curves are swept live in the browser — change the variable and the optimum often moves with it, which is why one single h for every component cannot be trusted.

步长为什么要能调。中心差分的误差有两段：截断误差约 O(h2)，随 h 变小而减小；舍入误差约 O(ϵ/h)（ϵ 为机器精度），随 h 变小反而增大。两者相抵，最佳步长大致在 h∼ϵ1/3，也就是 10−5 到 10−6 量级。把 h 调到 10−3 会看到截断误差主导，调到 10−10 会看到舍入噪声主导——两头都会让“验证”看起来像是失败了。这正是差分校验最容易骗人的地方，也是点积测试（第 8 节）比它更可靠的原因：点积测试是精确恒等式，根本不含步长。

Why the step has to be adjustable. The error of a central difference has two parts: truncation, about O(h2), which shrinks as h shrinks; and round-off, about O(ϵ/h) (with ϵ the machine precision), which grows as h shrinks. Between them the best step lies roughly at h∼ϵ1/3, of order 10−5 to 10−6. Set h to 10−3 and truncation dominates; set it to 10−10 and round-off noise does — at either end the "verification" looks like a failure. This is exactly where a difference check is most deceptive, and why the dot-product test (Section 8) is the more reliable of the two: it is an exact identity, with no step size in it at all.

那么哪一侧更糟？要看离最优点多远，因为两侧的斜率根本不同：h 每放大一个数量级，截断误差涨约 100 倍（二次）；h 每缩小一个数量级，舍入误差只涨约 10 倍（线性）。实测扫描里截断一侧的斜率很干净，舍入一侧则起伏不定（舍入误差本身近乎随机）；中心差分的最小值多数落在 h 约 10−4 到 10−6 之间，与 ϵ1/3 的量级一致。于是离最优点越远，偏大的那一侧通常越吃亏，但对个别分量两侧可能相差不到一个数量级。实用结论是——宁可把 h 取偏小，也不要取偏大。

So which side is worse? It depends how far from the optimum you are, because the two slopes are quite different: enlarging h by one order multiplies the truncation error by about 100 (quadratic), while shrinking h by one order multiplies the round-off error by only about 10 (linear). In the measured sweep the truncation slope is clean while the round-off side is ragged (round-off is close to random); the central minimum mostly lies between h≈10−4 and 10−6, consistent with the ϵ1/3 estimate. So the further from the optimum, the more the too-large side usually costs, though for a few components the two sides differ by less than an order of magnitude. The practical conclusion — better to take h a little too small than a little too large.

差分的步长两难，在第 13 节的复数步长那里不存在：那里没有相减，步长取 10−30，48 个分量与伴随梯度都相符到舍入误差。

The step dilemma of differences does not arise for the complex step of Section 13: nothing is subtracted there, the step is 10−30, and all 48 components agree with the adjoint gradient to round-off.

Added: smooth characteristic-boundary model

有限差分：完整重求解与步长扫描

Finite differences: reconverged solves and step-size sweeps

选择任意坐标或入流均值 a；每个扰动都重新计算几何、重构和边界值，再把原始方程收敛。支持中心、前向、后向差分以及 10⁻¹ 到 10⁻¹² 的步长。大步长可能改变边界分支或失去有效网格，出现这种情况应标记为不适合当前局部导数验证。

Select any coordinate or the inflow mean a. Each perturbation rebuilds geometry, reconstruction and boundary values and reconverges the primal. Central, forward and backward differences span steps from 10⁻¹ to 10⁻¹². Large perturbations can change boundary branches or invalidate the mesh and must be flagged as unsuitable for the current local derivative check.

gkCD(h)=J(u(p+hek),p+hek)−J(u(p−hek),p−hek)2h.g_k^{CD}(h)=\frac{J(u(p+h e_k),p+h e_k)-J(u(p-h e_k),p-h e_k)}{2h}.
第 13 节
Section 13

复数步长

The complex step

第 12 节的差分受步长两头夹击：截断误差要 h 小，舍入误差要 h 大。复数步长把这个两难拿掉：把一个节点坐标挪一个虚数步长 ih，整个 primal 求解用复数算，L 的虚部除以 h 就是导数：

The differences of Section 12 are squeezed from both sides: truncation wants a small h, round-off a large one. The complex step removes the dilemma: move one node coordinate by an imaginary step ih, run the whole primal solve in complex arithmetic, and the imaginary part of L, divided by h, is the derivative:

dLdXm=ImL(X+ihem)h+O(h2)

原因是 Taylor 展开：

The reason is the Taylor expansion:

L(X+ihem)=L(X)+ihdLdXm−h22d2LdXm2+O(h3)

实部与虚部各自分开：虚部的第一项就是 hdL/dXm，下一项已是 h3。这里没有两个相近的数相减，也就没有相消，h 可以取 10−30：O(h2) 的截断误差远在舍入误差之下。

Real and imaginary parts separate: the imaginary part starts with hdL/dXm, and its next term is already h3. No two nearly equal numbers are subtracted, so nothing cancels, and h can be 10−30: the O(h2) truncation error lies far below round-off.

具体实现

How to implement it

把残差里的每一个实数换成复数：每个未知量有实部与虚部两个数。被挪动的是一个节点坐标 Xm，复数从面法向进入。第 11 节的对偶面法向 nij=Σt∋(i,j)±(dy,−dx) 与边界半面的法向 12(yb−ya,−(xb−xa)) 都对坐标是线性的，所以复数法向正好是

Replace every real number in the residual by a complex one: every unknown carries a real and an imaginary part. What moves is one node coordinate Xm, and the complex numbers come in through the face normals. The dual-face normals of Section 11, nij=Σt∋(i,j)±(dy,−dx), and the boundary half-face normals 12(yb−ya,−(xb−xa)) are all linear in the coordinates, so the complex normal is exactly

n(X+ihem)=n(X)+ihn(em)

其中 n(em) 是同一个法向公式作用在第 m 个分量为 1、其余分量为 0 的坐标场上：它只落在被挪动节点所在单元里的对偶面上，以及以它为端点的边界边的两个半面上。vn=β·n 随之是复数。|n| 要当心：它得写成复数开方 (nx2+ny2)1/2，不能用复数的模，那是一个实数，会把虚部整个丢掉。h 这么小，这个开方就是

where n(em) is the same normal formula applied to the coordinate field that is 1 in component m and 0 in every other: it lives only on the dual faces inside the cells around the moved node and on the two half-faces of each boundary edge that ends at it. vn=β·n becomes complex with it. |n| needs care: it has to be the complex root (nx2+ny2)1/2, not the modulus of a complex number, which is real and would drop the imaginary part altogether. With h this small the root is

|n|=|Ren|+iRen·Imn|Ren|

其余照旧。通量 14vn(uL2+uR2)−ε|n|(uR−uL) 里只有加、减、乘；Jacobi 更新里有一次复数除法，用 Smith 算法：先用分母里绝对值较大的那个分量去除，免得平方溢出。远场按 Revn 的符号分入流与出流，与实数求解完全一样：分支只看实部，导数沿选中的分支照常传下去。目标 L=Σ壁面12uL2(n·e) 也用复数的 u 与 n 来算。边循环与 Jacobi 迭代都不变，只是每个数多带一个虚部；判据要连虚部一起看：ImR/h 的均方根也要低于 10−13。从 u* 出发时实部一开始就满足判据，只看它，迭代在第 0 轮就会停下，漏掉状态的响应。伪代码在的最上面。

Everything else stays. The flux 14vn(uL2+uR2)−ε|n|(uR−uL) needs only addition, subtraction and multiplication; the Jacobi update has one complex division, done by Smith's algorithm, which divides by the larger of the denominator's two parts first so that no square can overflow. The far field splits into inflow and outflow by the sign of Revn, exactly as in the real solve: a branch looks at the real part only, and the derivative passes through the branch taken as usual. The objective L=Σwall12uL2(n·e) is computed from the complex u and n too. The edge loop and the Jacobi iteration stay as they are; every number just carries an imaginary part. The criterion must watch the imaginary part as well: the rms of ImR/h must fall below 10−13 too. Started at u*, the real part meets the criterion from the start, and a test on it alone would stop the iteration at sweep 0 and miss the state's response. The pseudocode is at the top of .

从收敛流场出发

Starting from the converged flow

复数迭代从哪里出发并非无关紧要。从收敛解 u* 出发（虚部为零），实部停在不动点上（到舍入误差为止）。把残差在 u* 处展开，R(u*)=0：

Where the complex iteration starts matters. Started at the converged solution u* (imaginary part zero), the real part stays at the fixed point, to round-off. Expand the residual about u*, where R(u*)=0:

R(u*+ihv;X+ihem)=ih(Av+f)+O(h2),f=∂R∂Xm

于是 Jacobi 更新 u←u−D−1R(u) 的虚部除以 h 是

so the imaginary part of the Jacobi update u←u−D−1R(u), divided by h, is

v←v−D−1(Av+f),v=Imu/h

这里 D 也是复数（它由同一个复数边循环收集），所以更新里那个商的虚部完整写出来是

Here D is complex as well (the same complex edge loop collects it), so the imaginary part of the quotient in the update reads in full

Im(D−1R)=Re(D−1)ImR+Im(D−1)ReR

从 u* 出发，ReR 停在舍入误差上，第二项也只有舍入误差的量级，剩下的正是第 9 节的前向 Jacobi 迭代，只是 f 换成了 ∂R/∂Xm：v0=0，同一个 D。所以每一轮的 Imuk/h 就是前向迭代的 vk，不只是收敛后一致：48 个坐标、每一轮（共 300 轮），最大差（除以 max|v|）是 1.1e−14；实部与实数的 Jacobi 迭代逐比特相同（复数除法用 Smith 算法：虚部小到 h 的量级时，商的实部就是实数的那一次除法）。从初始流场 u≡1 出发就不同了：ReR≠0，第二项留下来，迭代把 D 也求了导，虚部是 primal 迭代值对坐标的导数：另一个序列，只在收敛时才到同一个极限。前几轮的差可达 max|v| 的 1.18 倍，而且每个分量都要把 primal 重解一遍。节点 7 的 y 从初始流场出发要 122 轮才满足判据，从 u* 出发与前向迭代一样是 120 轮。轮数相差不多，因为 primal 与前向迭代以同一个速率收敛（第 9 节）；差别在每一轮算出来的是什么。

Started at u*, ReR sits at round-off, so the second term is down at round-off too, and what is left is the forward Jacobi iteration of Section 9 with ∂R/∂Xm in place of f: v0=0, the same D. So Imuk/h is the forward iterate vk at every sweep, not only after convergence: over the 48 coordinates and every sweep (300 of them) the largest difference (over max|v|) is 1.1e−14, and the real part is the real Jacobi iterate to the last bit (the complex division is Smith's: with an imaginary part of the order of h, the real part of the quotient is the real division itself). Started at the initial field u≡1 it is different: ReR≠0, the second term stays, the iteration differentiates D as well, and the imaginary part is the derivative of the primal iterate with respect to the coordinate: another sequence, which reaches the same limit only at convergence. In the first sweeps the two differ by up to 1.18 times max|v|, and every component re-solves the primal. The y of node 7 needs 122 sweeps to meet the criterion from the initial field, and 120 from u*, the forward iteration's count. The counts are close because the primal and the forward iteration converge at the same rate (Section 9); what differs is what each sweep computes.

用复数步长验证梯度

The gradient, checked by the complex step

每个坐标一次复数求解，得到梯度的一个分量。48 个分量与伴随梯度之差的最大值（除以梯度的最大分量）是 2.2e−16，第 12 节的中心差分（h=10−6）是 3.6e−10：那里的差全是步长造成的。复数步长是精确的前向模式，所以它与伴随相符到舍入误差，是一个与步长无关的梯度检验。它的代价也是前向模式的代价：48 个分量要 48 次复数求解，伴随只要一次线性求解。所以它用来检验伴随，不用来代替伴随。在里选一个节点坐标和起点，看两条迭代逐轮重合或分开；图下的表把复数步长、伴随与中心差分的值并排列出。

One complex solve per coordinate gives one component of the gradient. Over the 48 components its largest difference from the adjoint gradient (over the gradient's largest component) is 2.2e−16, against 3.6e−10 for the central differences of Section 12 (h=10−6): that difference was all step size. The complex step is an exact forward mode, so it agrees with the adjoint to round-off, a gradient check whose result does not depend on the step size. Its cost is the forward mode's too: 48 components take 48 complex solves, where the adjoint takes one linear solve. So it checks the adjoint; it does not replace it. In pick a node coordinate and a start, and watch the two iterations coincide sweep by sweep, or part; the table under the plots lists the complex step, the adjoint and the central difference side by side.

Added: smooth characteristic-boundary model

复数步长：独立原始代数的校验

Complex step: an independent primal-algebra check

独立复数运算执行同一残差、边界函数与目标，h=10⁻²⁵。基准实部决定边界分支；线性校正使 Im(R)/h 收敛，然后从 Im(J)/h 取总导数。输出不是直接返回前向算子结果。最小二乘的坐标差、矩阵求逆、长度开方和正弦边界都保留复数虚部。

Independent complex arithmetic executes the same residual, boundary function and objective with h=10⁻²⁵. Baseline real values select boundary branches. Correct the imaginary residual until Im(R)/h converges, then read Im(J)/h. This is not a returned tangent derivative. Complex parts propagate through coordinate differences, least-squares inversion, lengths and the sine boundary.

第 14 节
Section 14

精度阶：构造解检验

Order of accuracy: a manufactured solution

伴随给出的是离散格式的精确导数，与格式本身是几阶精度无关；格式的精度阶决定的是离散解，以及由它算出的 L 与 dL/dX，离连续问题有多远。这一节用构造解把它测出来：先选一个光滑函数当精确解，由它反推出源项与边界数据，再在一族逐次一致加密的网格上求解，看误差随网格尺寸按几次方减小。

The adjoint gives the exact derivative of the discrete scheme, whatever that scheme's order of accuracy; the order decides how far the discrete solution, and the L and dL/dX computed from it, are from the continuous problem. This section measures it with a manufactured solution: pick a smooth function as the exact solution, derive the source term and the boundary data from it, solve on a family of uniformly refined meshes, and see with what power of the mesh size the error falls.

构造解

The manufactured solution

ue(x,y)=12+14sin(0.9x+0.3)cos(0.7y−0.2)

与二维对流扩散页面用的是同一个函数。它处处介于 0.25 与 0.75 之间，与本页算例的解同号（u>0），所以对流速度 uβ·n 的符号与原问题相同，远场上入流与出流的划分也不变。它的一阶导数：

It is the same function as on the advection–diffusion pages. It lies between 0.25 and 0.75 everywhere, of the same sign as this page's solution (u>0), so the convective speed uβ·n has the same signs as in the original problem, and the far field splits into the same inflow and outflow parts. Its first derivatives:

∂ue∂x=0.225cos(0.9x+0.3)cos(0.7y−0.2)
∂ue∂y=−0.175sin(0.9x+0.3)sin(0.7y−0.2)

源项

The source term

在方程右端加一个源项 s，让 ue 恰好是它的解：

Put a source term s on the right-hand side and make ue its exact solution:

∇·(12u2β)=s
s=ueβ·∇ue=ue(∂ue∂x+0.5∂ue∂y)

这里用到 β=(1,0.5) 是常数：∇·(12u2β)=uβ·∇u。离散时每个控制体只取源项的一个值（单点积分），从残差里减去：

This uses β=(1,0.5) being constant: ∇·(12u2β)=uβ·∇u. The discrete source takes one value per control volume (a one-point quadrature) and is subtracted from the residual:

Ri(u)←Ri(u)−s(xi)|Ωi|

其中 |Ωi| 是节点 i 的中位对偶控制体的面积，源项就在节点 xi 上求值。

where |Ωi| is the area of the median-dual control volume of node i, and the source is evaluated at the node xi itself.

边界数据

The boundary data

远场照原问题按特征方向划分：入流半面的外侧状态取 ue，在半面的中点 xf 求值；出流半面照旧外推：

The far field splits by the characteristic direction as in the original problem: the outer state of an inflow half-face is ue at its midpoint xf, and an outflow half-face extrapolates as before:

uR=ue(xf)(vn<0)
uR=uL(vn≥0)

物面在这一节里也按同一条规则处理：流体从物面流进计算域的地方（vn<0，特征进入计算域）给 ue；流体撞向物面的迎风一侧（vn>0，特征离开计算域）外推。于是整条边界上只在特征进入的地方给数据，构造解问题是适定的。本页算例的壁面在每个壁面半面上规定通量；为什么不能把它照搬过来，见本节最后一小节。

In this section the body follows the same rule: where the flow leaves the body into the domain (vn<0, characteristics enter the domain) the outer state is ue, and on the windward side, where the flow runs into the body (vn>0, characteristics leave the domain), the state is extrapolated. Data are then given only where characteristics enter, along the whole boundary, and the manufactured problem is well posed. The wall of this page's test case prescribes the flux on every one of its wall half-faces; why that cannot simply be carried over is the subject of the last part of this section.

网格族

The mesh family

从 24 个单元的基础网格出发，每加密一层：每个三角形用三条边的中点分成 4 个三角形，每个四边形用四条边的中点与顶点平均点分成 4 个四边形，边界边在中点处一分为二。物面与远场都是直边八边形，所以每一层的计算域完全相同，网格尺寸逐层减半，hℓ=h0/2ℓ。7 层网格有 24、96、384、1536、6144、24576、98304 个单元，24、80、288、1088、4224、16640、66048 个节点。这就是二维对流扩散页面用的那一族网格，只是多加密了几层，原因见下文。

Starting from the 24-cell base mesh, each refinement splits every triangle into 4 triangles through its edge midpoints and every quadrilateral into 4 quadrilaterals through its edge midpoints and its vertex average, and every boundary edge in two at its midpoint. The body and the far field are both straight-edged octagons, so the domain is exactly the same on every level and the mesh size halves from one level to the next, hℓ=h0/2ℓ. The 7 meshes have 24, 96, 384, 1536, 6144, 24576, 98304 cells and 24, 80, 288, 1088, 4224, 16640, 66048 nodes. It is the family of the advection–diffusion pages, refined a few levels further, for a reason that comes below.

误差与观测阶

The error and the observed order

误差在节点上量，与 ue 在节点的值比较，用对偶控制体面积加权的 L2 范数与最大范数：

The error is measured at the nodes, against ue there, in the L2 norm weighted by the dual control-volume areas and in the max norm:

‖e‖2=(Σi|Ωi|(ui−ue(xi))2Σi|Ωi|)1/2
‖e‖∞=maxi|ui−ue(xi)|

相邻两层的网格尺寸之比正好是 2，所以观测阶是误差之比以 2 为底的对数：

The mesh sizes of two neighbouring levels differ by exactly a factor of 2, so the observed order is the base-2 logarithm of the error ratio:

pℓ=log2‖e‖ℓ−1‖e‖ℓ
‖e‖ℓ≈Chℓp

每一层都用第 5 节的 Jacobi 迭代求解：先迭代到判据满足（残差的均方根小于 10−13），比如在第 k 轮，再多跑 k 轮，这时已经落在舍入误差平台上。网格越密，Jacobi 越慢：最细一层要 3633 轮才满足判据。离散解与求解器无关，误差表不受影响。本页格式的结果：

Every level is solved by the Jacobi iteration of Section 5: iterated until the criterion is met (the rms residual below 10−13), at some sweep k, and then k sweeps more, by which time it is on its round-off floor. The finer the mesh, the slower Jacobi: the finest level takes 3633 sweeps to meet the criterion. The discrete solution does not depend on the solver, and the error table is not affected. 把两种格式的 L2 与最大范数误差画在同一张双对数图上。

puts the L2 and the max-norm errors of both schemes on one logarithmic plot.

一阶，但来得很慢

First order, but slowly

对流通量里的耗散项可以写成扩散两点通量的样子。设 d 是从左侧节点指向右侧节点的边向量，且与 n 平行：

The dissipation in the convective flux can be written as a two-point diffusive flux. Let d be the edge vector from the left node to the right one, and let it be parallel to n:

−ε|n|(uR−uL)=−νnum|n|uR−uL|d|
νnum=ε|d|=O(h)

离散格式实际上是在解多了一个扩散项、扩散系数为 O(h) 的方程，误差应当是 O(h)：格式的设计精度是一阶。实测的 L2 阶是从下面一步步往 1 爬的：本页 0.47、0.54、0.58、0.65、0.73、0.82，格心页面 0.42、0.48、0.60、0.72、0.81、0.87。本页最大范数的阶 0.21、0.40、0.43、0.49、0.58、0.70 也在爬；格心页面的最大范数阶不那么整齐，先降后升。

The discrete scheme is in effect solving the equation with an added diffusion of coefficient O(h), so its error should be O(h): the design order is one. The measured L2 orders climb towards 1 from below, one level at a time: 0.47, 0.54, 0.58, 0.65, 0.73, 0.82 on this page, 0.42, 0.48, 0.60, 0.72, 0.81, 0.87 on the cell-centred page. This page's max-norm orders, 0.21, 0.40, 0.43, 0.49, 0.58, 0.70, climb too; the cell-centred page's are less orderly and fall before they rise.

为什么这么慢？把 ue 代进离散方程，每单位面积剩下的残差就是截断误差：

Why so slowly? Put ue into the discrete equations; what remains of the residual per unit area is the truncation error:

τi=Ri(ue)|Ωi|

在规则网格上，一阶格式的截断误差是 O(h)。在这张不规则网格上并非如此：在本页，它的 L2 范数逐层是 1.6e−1、1.3e−1、8.9e−2、6.2e−2、4.3e−2、3.0e−2、2.1e−2，每加密一次的阶只有 0.38、0.50、0.52、0.52、0.51、0.51，大约是 h1/2；在格心页面上，它几乎不变。不规则的控制体各个面上的 Taylor 展开项在控制体内并不逐点抵消。可是解的误差照样在减小：相邻控制体的局部误差在解里互相抵消，误差仍然是一阶的（这叫超收敛）。这种抵消是逐层慢慢显现出来的，耗散越强显现得越慢：把 ε 从 0.8 换成 0.3，同一层上的 L2 阶就从 0.65 升到 0.82（格心页面从 0.72 升到 0.86）。 把截断误差与解的误差画在一起。

On a regular mesh the truncation error of a first-order scheme is O(h). On this irregular mesh it is not: here its L2 norm is 1.6e−1, 1.3e−1, 8.9e−2, 6.2e−2, 4.3e−2, 3.0e−2, 2.1e−2 level by level, the orders only 0.38, 0.50, 0.52, 0.52, 0.51, 0.51, about h1/2; on the cell-centred page it hardly changes. The Taylor terms of the faces of an irregular control volume do not cancel pointwise inside it. The solution error falls all the same: the local errors of neighbouring control volumes cancel in the solution, and the error is still first order (supraconvergence). That cancellation shows itself only gradually, level by level, and the more slowly the stronger the dissipation: with ε=0.3 instead of 0.8 the L2 order on the same level rises from 0.65 to 0.82 (the cell-centred page: from 0.72 to 0.86). draws the truncation error beside the solution error.

为什么不能照搬本页的壁面

Why this page's wall cannot be carried over

本页算例的壁面在每个壁面半面上规定通量（h=0）。照搬到构造解问题上，就是在每个壁面半面上规定精确解的法向通量 12ue(xf)2vn。在流体撞向物面的迎风一侧（vn>0），特征离开计算域；这里通量 12u2vn 一旦给定，u 本身也就给定了，问题多了一个条件。这与第 3 节解释本页为什么没有 Dirichlet 壁面的，是同一个理由。

The wall of this page's test case prescribes the flux on every one of its wall half-faces (h=0). Carried over to the manufactured problem, that means prescribing the exact solution's normal flux 12ue(xf)2vn on every one of them. On the windward side, where the flow runs into the body (vn>0), characteristics leave the domain; there a given flux 12u2vn gives u itself, and the problem has one condition too many. It is the same reason Section 3 gives for this page having no Dirichlet wall.

实测：在每个壁面半面上都规定通量时，迎风侧壁面控制体上的最大误差逐层是 2.3e−2、2.7e−2、3.1e−2、5.3e−2、6.8e−2、8.1e−2，并不减小；其余地方的最大误差是 1.1e−1、9.1e−2、6.9e−2、5.1e−2、4.1e−2、4.3e−2。L2 误差仍在减小（阶 0.52、0.55、0.57、0.63、0.71），因为出问题的只是贴着迎风侧壁面的一层，这一层随网格加密越来越薄。 把两者画在一起。

Measured: with the flux prescribed on every one of the wall half-faces, the max error on the windward wall control volumes is 2.3e−2, 2.7e−2, 3.1e−2, 5.3e−2, 6.8e−2, 8.1e−2 level by level, and does not fall; everywhere else it is 1.1e−1, 9.1e−2, 6.9e−2, 5.1e−2, 4.1e−2, 4.3e−2. The L2 error still falls (orders 0.52, 0.55, 0.57, 0.63, 0.71), because the trouble is confined to one layer against the windward wall, and that layer gets thinner with every refinement. draws the two side by side.

这对伴随意味着什么

What this means for the adjoint

第 10–13 节验证的是：伴随与几何梯度对离散的 L 精确到舍入误差，这与格式几阶无关。离散的 L 离连续值有多远，本节没有直接测：构造解换掉了壁面条件，而 L 正是在壁面控制体上取值，其中包括迎风侧的那些；上一小节表明，照本页壁面的做法，那里的误差并不随网格减小。优化器拿到的梯度与它所优化的离散目标函数完全一致，问题是自洽的；网格加密决定的是这个离散问题离连续问题有多近。要让它更近，得提高格式的阶（例如对流通量用重构），而不是改伴随。

What Sections 10 to 13 verified is that the adjoint and the geometric gradient are exact, to round-off, for the discrete L, whatever the scheme's order. How far the discrete L is from a continuous value is not measured here: the manufactured problem replaces the wall condition, and L is evaluated on the wall control volumes, the windward ones included, where, with this page's wall, the error does not fall (the previous subsection). The gradient the optimiser gets agrees exactly with the discrete objective it optimises, so the problem is self-consistent; refinement decides how close that discrete problem is to the continuous one. To bring it closer one has to raise the scheme's order (a reconstruction in the convective flux, say), not change the adjoint.

新增：光滑特征边界模型
Added: smooth characteristic-boundary model

精度阶：同一光滑、无源问题上的加密

Accuracy: refinement of the same smooth source-free problem

一阶、二阶使用完全相同的解析解与特征边界，没有切换成不同物理问题。每次把三角形或四边形细分为四块，保留原多边形内外边界。一阶误差在这组粗网格上仍受较强耗散控制，不能把尚未达到 1 的实测阶写成 1；二阶在最后两级已接近 2。

Both orders use exactly the same analytic solution and characteristic boundaries. Each refinement splits triangles or quadrilaterals into four while preserving polygonal boundaries. Strong first-order dissipation delays the asymptotic regime on these grids; measured rates below one must not be relabelled one. Second order approaches two on the final levels.

Eh=∑iVi(ui−uiref)2∑iVi,q=log⁡2(Eh/Eh/2).E_h=\sqrt{\frac{\sum_iV_i(u_i-u_i^{ref})^2}{\sum_iV_i}},\qquad q=\log_2(E_h/E_{h/2}).

格点比较解析节点值；格心比较解析场的控制体平均值，采用独立体积分求积。图表显示实际数值，不用理论斜率替换测量曲线。

Compare analytic nodal values on the node grid and independently integrated control-volume averages on the cell grid. Plots show measured errors, not replacement curves with prescribed slopes.

第 15 节
Section 15

伴随一致性：结论与阅读范围

Adjoint consistency: conclusions and scope

原算例的零数值通量内壁不提供所需的光滑、正值连续参考。附录另设特征边界对照；它的加密结果不能用来证明原零通量算例的连续一致性。原算例仍需通过自己的离散转置与梯度检验。

The original zero numerical wall flux does not supply the required smooth positive continuous reference. The appendix uses a separate characteristic-boundary contrast; its refinement cannot establish continuous consistency of the original zero-flux case. The original case retains its own discrete transpose and gradient checks.

点积测试检查离散转置，差分和复数步长检查同一离散目标的梯度。独立连续参考回答另一问题：加密后是否趋向相同的连续灵敏度。误差不下降时，先核对边界、目标、乘子含义、正则性和参考误差，再讨论适定性。

Dot tests check the discrete transpose; finite differences and complex steps check the gradient of the same discrete objective. An independent continuous reference asks a different question: whether refinement approaches the same continuous sensitivity. A discrepancy calls for checking boundaries, objectives, multiplier interpretation, regularity and reference error before diagnosing well-posedness.

附录 A集中给出完整推导、参考实现、图与交互；可先继续阅读离散伴随主线。

Appendix A contains the full derivation, reference implementation, figures and interaction. You can continue the discrete-adjoint lesson first.

新增：光滑特征边界模型
Added: smooth characteristic-boundary model

连续伴随：边界条件随目标一起改变

Continuous adjoint: boundary conditions change with the objective

新的原始边界有明确的光滑正值参考，旧零通量问题的“不存在光滑参考”结论不再适用。但光滑原始解不保证伴随处处光滑：本目标只作用于内边界，特征线终止在内边界或外边界时得到不同的伴随末端值。附录 B 给出推导及射线追踪参考。

The new primal boundary admits a smooth positive reference; the former zero-flux problem’s lack of such a reference no longer applies. A smooth primal does not ensure a globally smooth adjoint: this objective acts only on the inner boundary, giving different terminal data to characteristics ending on inner versus outer boundaries. Appendix B derives and traces the reference.

离散点积与梯度验证检查的是当前程序，连续比较检查的是网格极限。这两个证据不能互相替代；尤其不能用原始解的二阶误差自动宣布伴随跨特征分界的最大范数也二阶。

Discrete dot products and gradient tests validate the program; continuous comparisons study its mesh limit. Neither replaces the other, and second-order primal errors do not imply second-order adjoint maximum-norm convergence across characteristic interfaces.

打开附录 B 的射线追踪与逐点比较

Open ray tracing and pointwise comparison in Appendix B

离散乘子与连续场为什么不能直接混用

Why a discrete multiplier is not automatically a continuous field

正文使用普通数组点积定义 A_hᵀ。若另选带权内积，算子的伴随就会改变：状态权矩阵为 W_U、残差权矩阵为 W_R 时，带权伴随是 W_U⁻¹A_hᵀW_R。代码的普通转置不能在没有换元说明的情况下被写成该带权算子。

The main derivation defines A_hᵀ using ordinary array dot products. A weighted inner product changes the adjoint: with state and residual weights W_U and W_R it is W_U⁻¹A_hᵀW_R. The coded ordinary transpose cannot be relabelled as that weighted operator without a change of variables.

⟨Ahv,w⟩WR=vTAhTWRw=⟨v,Ah†w⟩WU,Ah†=WU−1AhTWR.\langle A_hv,w\rangle_{W_R}=v^TA_h^TW_Rw=\langle v,A_h^\dagger w\rangle_{W_U},\qquad A_h^\dagger=W_U^{-1}A_h^TW_R.

残差的归一化也会改变乘子的数值。若改为 R̃_h=D⁻¹R_h，D 为可逆行尺度矩阵，则在收敛解上 Ã_h=D⁻¹A_h，ψ̃_h=Dᵀψ_h；目标总梯度保持不变。即使 D 随设计改变，由 δD 产生的项也乘以 R_h，在精确收敛时为零。把控制体积分残差改成体积平均残差后，不能仍直接比较原来的乘子曲线。

Residual normalization also changes multiplier values. For R̃_h=D⁻¹R_h with an invertible row-scaling matrix D, at convergence Ã_h=D⁻¹A_h and ψ̃_h=Dᵀψ_h, while the total objective gradient is unchanged. Even when D depends on design, terms from δD multiply R_h and vanish at exact convergence. Multipliers of integrated and volume-normalized residuals cannot be compared without rescaling.

连续附录从微分方程、积分目标和分部积分出发；正文从实际离散残差及其有限维链式法则出发。两者可以比较同一参数的目标总导数与加密极限，但还须匹配符号、变量、积分权重和边界约束。边界替换行的乘子尤其不能直接解释为连续场采样值。

The continuous appendix starts from differential equations, integral objectives and integration by parts; the main text starts from actual discrete residuals and finite-dimensional chain rules. Compare total derivatives of the same objective and parameter and their refinement limits, after matching signs, variables, weights and boundary constraints. Multipliers of replaced boundary rows especially are not direct samples of a continuous field.

与格心格式的对照

Compared with the cell-centred scheme

未知量在哪Where the unknowns live单元中心cell centres网格节点mesh nodes
控制体Control volume单元本身（四边形或三角形）the cell itself (quadrilateral or triangle)中位对偶体（中点—中心连线围成）the median dual, bounded by the midpoint-to-centre lines
未知量个数Number of unknowns24（8 四边形 + 16 三角形）24 (8 quadrilaterals + 16 triangles)24（节点）24 (nodes)
面Faces48 条边48 edges48 个对偶面 + 32 个边界半面 = 8048 dual faces + 32 boundary half-faces = 80
每个控制体的面数Faces per control volume3 或 4（看单元类型）3 or 4, depending on the cell type内部节点等于相邻节点数（本算例都是 5）；边界节点是相邻节点数（壁面 3、远场 4）再加两个边界半面（算例中每个控制体 5 或 6 个面）for an interior node, the number of neighbouring nodes (5 everywhere in this mesh); a boundary node has its neighbours (3 on the wall, 4 on the far field) plus its two boundary half-faces (5 or 6 faces per control volume here)
对角元 DDiagonal D都逐个不同（壁面不贡献、出流面导数不同）different entry by entry in both (the wall contributes nothing, and an outflow face has a different derivative)
边循环结构Structure of the loop完全相同：收集 → 一维通量 → 分发identical: gather → one-dimensional flux → scatter
前向 / 伴随Forward / adjoint完全相同：只依赖 cL,cR 与分发符号identical: they depend only on cL,cR and the scatter signs
  • 对偶控制体是造出来的：在每个单元内把边中点与单元中心相连，拼出每个节点的控制体；三角形恰好三等分，四边形不是四等分，所以体积要逐块累加。
  • The dual control volume has to be constructed: inside each cell join the edge midpoints to the cell centre, and assemble the control volume of every node from the pieces; a triangle divides into exactly three equal parts, but a quadrilateral does not divide into four, so the volume has to be accumulated piece by piece.
  • 边界条件只住在 flux 里面：无粘壁面取 h=0，远场按特征方向选入流/出流；边循环一行都不用改。
  • Boundary conditions live inside flux alone: an inviscid wall takes h=0, and the far field picks inflow or outflow by the characteristic direction; not one line of the edge loop changes.
  • 一维通量是核心：控制体造好之后，残差就是“对每个对偶面调用一次一维通量，再收集与分发”。
  • The one-dimensional flux is the core: once the control volumes are built, the residual is simply "call the one-dimensional flux once per dual face, then gather and scatter".
  • matrix-free 前向：对一维通量求局部导数 cL,cR，边循环不变。
  • Matrix-free forward: take the local derivatives cL,cR of the one-dimensional flux; the edge loop is unchanged.
  • matrix-free 伴随：每个面的贡献转置——一维通量从“两个输入、一个输出”变为“一个输入、两个输出”，边循环中收集与分发互换、数据方向反转。
  • Matrix-free adjoint: transpose the contribution of each face — the one-dimensional flux goes from "two inputs, one output" to "one input, two outputs", and in the edge loop gather and scatter swap while the data direction reverses.
  • 求解：primal、切线、伴随三个方程都用同一个 Jacobi 迭代，只用到对角元 D 与 matrix-free 的乘积；进入渐近阶段以后，三者以同一个速率收敛（谱半径 0.797）。
  • Solving: the primal, tangent and adjoint equations are all solved by the same Jacobi iteration, which needs only the diagonal D and the matrix-free products; once asymptotic, all three converge at the same rate (spectral radius 0.797).
  • 验证：点积测试检查转置，差分与复数步长检查梯度。复数步长从收敛解出发，每一轮都与前向迭代一致，与伴随梯度相符到舍入误差。
  • Verification: the dot-product test checks the transpose, finite differences and the complex step check the gradient. Started from the converged solution, the complex step matches the forward iteration at every sweep, and the adjoint gradient to round-off.
  • 精度阶：构造解检验（第 14 节）表明格式是一阶的，耗散项相当于一个系数为 O(h) 的扩散。在这张不规则网格上一阶来得很慢：L2 阶逐层往 1 爬，最细一层是 0.82（格心页面 0.87）。伴随对离散的 L 始终是精确的；格式的阶决定的是离散问题离连续问题有多远。
  • Order of accuracy: a manufactured solution (Section 14) shows the scheme to be first order, the dissipation acting as a diffusion of coefficient O(h). On this irregular mesh first order comes slowly: the L2 orders climb towards 1 level by level, 0.82 on the finest level (0.87 on the cell-centred page). The adjoint is exact for the discrete L either way; the order decides how far the discrete problem is from the continuous one.

本页交互面板里的数字（收敛解、Jacobian、前向与伴随结果、梯度、差分与复数步长）都由页面中的脚本在加载时实时计算；正文、表格与静态图中引用的数值由同一份模型代码预先算出。

The numbers in the interactive panels — the converged solution, the Jacobian, the forward and adjoint results, the gradients, the differences and the complex step — are computed live by the page’s own scripts as it loads; the values quoted in the text, the tables and the static figures were computed in advance from the same model code.

新增：光滑特征边界模型
Added: smooth characteristic-boundary model

总结：保留面循环，补全重构与边界求导

Summary: retain face loops, complete reconstruction and boundary differentiation

保留原网格、内部通量、守恒分发与内边界积分目标的形式；必要的改动是内外边界统一特征处理，以及二阶梯度、分段积分和完整导数链。一阶保留 Jacobi；二阶采用一阶 GS 预处理的精确算子求解。全部状态和几何导数均对应当前选定的离散。

Keep the original mesh, interior flux, conservative scatter and inner-boundary functional form. Necessary changes are characteristic treatment on both boundaries and second-order gradients, segment integration and complete derivative paths. First order retains Jacobi; second order solves with exact operators and first-order GS preconditioning. All state and geometry derivatives match the selected discretisation.

这里没有激波、限制器或湍流。解析目标为零，离散目标和梯度反映网格误差；页面区分这种教学验证与实际工程优化目标。接下来走向更复杂方程时，应逐项增加新物理与离散算子，并保留可独立核查的导数验证。

There are no shocks, limiters or turbulence here. The analytic objective is zero; discrete objective and gradient values reflect mesh error. This teaching test is distinguished from an engineering optimisation objective. More complex equations should add physics and discrete operators together with independently checkable derivative tests.

/* The mesh of the advection-diffusion pages: the advection pages'
   asymmetric hybrid O-mesh, node for node and cell for cell, and its
   uniform subdivisions (the family the order study runs on). Shared by the
   cell-centred and the node-centred core. */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  const key = (a, b) => Math.min(a, b) + "-" + Math.max(a, b);

  /* ---- the base mesh: the advection pages' asymmetric hybrid O-mesh,
     node for node and cell for cell ---- */
  function baseMesh() {
    const NR = 3, NT = 8;
    const BODY = [0.10, -0.04], ROUT = 1.9, LAYER = 0.45;
    const rBody = th => 0.55 * (1 + 0.28 * Math.cos(th) + 0.12 * Math.sin(2 * th));
    const X = [], inner = [], outer = [];
    for (let k = 0; k < NT; k++) {
      const th = 2 * Math.PI * k / NT;
      inner.push([BODY[0] + rBody(th) * Math.cos(th), BODY[1] + rBody(th) * Math.sin(th)]);
      outer.push([ROUT * Math.cos(th), ROUT * Math.sin(th)]);
    }
    const mid = inner.map((p, k) => [(1 - LAYER) * p[0] + LAYER * outer[k][0],
      (1 - LAYER) * p[1] + LAYER * outer[k][1]]);
    inner.forEach(p => X.push(p));
    mid.forEach(p => X.push(p));
    outer.forEach(p => X.push(p));
    const nid = (r, k) => r * NT + ((k % NT) + NT) % NT + 1;
    const C2N = [];
    for (let r = 0; r < NR - 1; r++) {
      for (let k = 0; k < NT; k++) {
        const a = nid(r, k), b = nid(r, k + 1), c = nid(r + 1, k + 1), d = nid(r + 1, k);
        if (r === 0) C2N.push([a, d, c, b]);            // quadrilateral, counter-clockwise
        else { C2N.push([a, d, c]); C2N.push([a, c, b]); }
      }
    }
    const bnd = {};
    for (let k = 0; k < NT; k++) {
      bnd[key(nid(0, k), nid(0, k + 1))] = "wall";
      bnd[key(nid(NR - 1, k), nid(NR - 1, k + 1))] = "far";
    }
    return { X, C2N, bnd, BODY };
  }

  /* ---- uniform subdivision: every triangle into four by its edge
     midpoints, every quadrilateral into four through its centre. The
     boundary is polygonal, so the domain is the same at every level and the
     meshes form one self-similar family. ---- */
  function subdivide(mesh) {
    const X = mesh.X.map(p => p.slice());
    const midOf = {};
    const mp = (a, b) => {
      const k = key(a, b);
      if (!midOf[k]) {
        X.push([(X[a - 1][0] + X[b - 1][0]) / 2, (X[a - 1][1] + X[b - 1][1]) / 2]);
        midOf[k] = X.length;
      }
      return midOf[k];
    };
    const C2N = [];
    mesh.C2N.forEach(v => {
      if (v.length === 3) {
        const [a, b, c] = v, ab = mp(a, b), bc = mp(b, c), ca = mp(c, a);
        C2N.push([a, ab, ca], [ab, b, bc], [ca, bc, c], [ab, bc, ca]);
      } else {
        const [a, b, c, d] = v, ab = mp(a, b), bc = mp(b, c), cd = mp(c, d), da = mp(d, a);
        X.push([0, 1].map(t => (X[a - 1][t] + X[b - 1][t] + X[c - 1][t] + X[d - 1][t]) / 4));
        const m = X.length;
        C2N.push([a, ab, m, da], [ab, b, bc, m], [m, bc, c, cd], [da, m, cd, d]);
      }
    });
    const bnd = {};
    Object.keys(mesh.bnd).forEach(k => {
      const [a, b] = k.split("-").map(Number), m = midOf[k];
      bnd[key(a, m)] = mesh.bnd[k];
      bnd[key(m, b)] = mesh.bnd[k];
    });
    return { X, C2N, bnd };
  }

  window.MESHAD = { baseMesh, subdivide, key };
})();

function preconditioner(u,p=params,trans=false){const E=evaluate(real,u,p,1),rows=Array.from({length:n},()=>new Map());const put=(i,j,v)=>rows[i].set(j,(rows[i].get(j)||0)+v);for(const f of E.faces){const ul=u[f.L],ur=f.R>=0?u[f.R]:f.vn<0?f.samples[0].ur:ul,cl=.5*f.vn*ul+.8*f.len,cr=.5*f.vn*ur-.8*f.len,aa=f.R<0&&f.vn>=0?cl+cr:cl;put(f.L,f.L,aa);if(f.R>=0){put(f.L,f.R,cr);put(f.R,f.L,-aa);put(f.R,f.R,-cr);}}const P=trans?Array.from({length:n},()=>new Map()):rows;if(trans)rows.forEach((row,i)=>row.forEach((v,j)=>P[j].set(i,v)));return rhs=>{let x=zeros(n);for(let k=0;k<3;k++)for(let it=0;it<n;it++){const i=trans?n-1-it:it;let v=rhs[i];for(const [j,a]of P[i])if(j!==i)v-=a*x[j];x[i]=v/P[i].get(i);}return x;};}
function diagonal(u,p=params){const e=evaluate(real,u,p,1),d=zeros(n);for(const f of e.faces){const ul=u[f.L],ur=f.samples[0].ur,cl=.5*f.vn*ul+.8*f.len,cr=.5*f.vn*ur-.8*f.len;d[f.L]+=f.R<0&&f.vn>=0?cl+cr:cl;if(f.R>=0)d[f.R]-=cr;}return d;}
function linear(L,rhs,u,p=params,trans=false){const op=v=>trans?L.vjp(v).u:L.jvp(v).R,pre=preconditioner(u,p,trans);if(order===1){const D=diagonal(u,p),x=zeros(n),history=[],states=[];for(let it=0;it<8000;it++){const ax=op(x),r=rhs.map((v,i)=>v-ax[i]);history.push(norm(r));states.push(x.slice());if(history.at(-1)<2e-14)return {x,history,states,residual:history.at(-1)};x.forEach((v,i)=>x[i]=v+r[i]/D[i]);}throw Error('Linear Jacobi failed');}let x=zeros(n),history=[norm(rhs)],states=[x.slice()];for(let cycle=0;cycle<15;cycle++){const ax=op(x),r=rhs.map((v,i)=>v-ax[i]),g=gmres(op,r,pre,2e-14,Math.min(n,60));states.push(...g.states.slice(1).map(z=>z.map((v,i)=>v+x[i])));x=x.map((v,i)=>v+g.x[i]);history.push(...g.history.slice(1));const res=norm(op(x).map((v,i)=>v-rhs[i]));if(res<1e-13)return {x,history,states,residual:res};}throw Error('Linear solve did not converge '+history.at(-1));}
function solve(p=params,start){if(order===1){let u=start?start.slice():Array(n).fill(p[2*nx]),history=[],states=[];for(let it=0;it<10000;it++){const R=evaluate(real,u,p).R;history.push(norm(R));states.push(u.slice());if(history.at(-1)<8e-14)return {u,history,states,residual:history.at(-1)};const D=diagonal(u,p);u=u.map((v,i)=>v-R[i]/D[i]);if(!u.every(v=>v>0&&Number.isFinite(v)))throw Error('Non-positive Jacobi update');}throw Error('Primal Jacobi failed');}let u=start?start.slice():Array(n).fill(p[2*nx]),history=[],states=[];for(let it=0;it<45;it++){const L=linearize(u,p),r=norm(L.R);history.push(r);states.push(u.slice());if(r<2e-13)return {u,history,states,residual:r};const d=linear(L,L.R.map(v=>-v),u,p).x;let step=1,un;while(step>1e-8){un=u.map((v,i)=>v+step*d[i]);const ev=evaluate(real,un,p),valid=un.every(v=>v>0)&&ev.faces.every(f=>f.samples.every(s=>s.ul>0&&s.ur>0));if(valid&&norm(ev.R)<r*(1-1e-4*step))break;step*=.5;}if(step<=1e-8)throw Error('No positive smooth update');u=un;}throw Error('Nonlinear solve failed');}
function sensitivities(sol,p=params){const L=linearize(sol.u,p),g=L.vjp(zeros(n),1),s=linear(L,g.u.map(v=>-v),sol.u,p,true);return {...s,gradient:L.vjp(s.x,1).p,L};}
function cs(sol,k,p=params,h=1e-25){const L=linearize(sol.u,p),u=sol.u.map(v=>[v,0]),pp=p.map((v,i)=>[v,k===i?h:0]);for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const R=evaluate(complex,u,pp).R.map(v=>-v[1]/h);if(norm(R)<1e-13)break;const d=linear(L,R,sol.u,p).x;u.forEach((v,i)=>v[1]+=h*d[i]);}const out=evaluate(complex,u,pp);return {gradient:out.J[1]/h,residual:norm(out.R.map(v=>v[1]/h))};}
return {n,nx,node,order,mesh,params,neighbors,evaluate:(u,p=params)=>evaluate(real,u,p),linearize,solve,sensitivities,linear,cs,preconditioner};}
const api={model,...Q};if(typeof module!=='undefined')module.exports=api;else root.Transport2=api;
})(typeof window!=='undefined'?window:globalThis);

附录 A · 连续伴随：简单算例的验证与对比

Appendix A · Continuous adjoints: verification and comparison for simple cases

本项目以离散伴随为主线：从可逐句检查的小模型，逐步走向工业级非结构网格 RANS 的完整离散伴随实现。连续伴随在简单算例中提供独立验证与对比，不是学习后续章节的前提。

This project follows discrete adjoints, from small models whose operations can be inspected statement by statement toward a complete industrial unstructured-grid RANS discrete adjoint. Continuous adjoints provide independent checks and comparisons for simple cases; they are not a prerequisite for later chapters.

这里的“走向”是项目目标，并不表示当前已实现 RANS。可以为选定的连续 RANS 模型推导形式伴随；但不能据此假定它严格对应工业求解器中的湍流闭合、壁面处理、限幅、边界与网格算法。最终需要验证的是实际离散残差及目标的导数。

RANS is the project destination, not a capability already implemented here. A formal continuous adjoint can be derived for a specified continuous RANS model; this does not establish strict equivalence to an industrial solver’s turbulence closure, wall treatment, limiters, boundary and mesh algorithms. The derivatives to verify are those of the implemented discrete residual and objective.

A.1 完整推导与适定性

A.1 Full derivation and well-posedness

1. 符号、积分测度与三类不同的检查

将定常 PDE 写为 R(u,p)=0，目标泛函记为 J，采用拉格朗日泛函

L=J−∫ΩλTR dΩ.\mathcal L=J-\int_\Omega\lambda^T R\,d\Omega.

页面求解的是 A_h^T ψ_h = −g_h。这里的连续乘子采用相反符号：在守恒方程上有 λ_h=−ψ_h。这些残差已经是控制体积分后的守恒平衡，不需要再除以控制体的体积或面积。被代数边界约束替换的行对应约束乘子，其数值不是连续场的点值。

三类检查分别回答不同的问题：

  1. 转置／点积测试检查 A_h^T 的实现。
  2. 对同一离散问题做有限差分，检查 dJ_h/dp。
  3. 将独立求得的连续伴随与一系列加密网格上的离散伴随比较，检查指定范数下的一致性。比较时必须匹配 PDE、边界条件、目标泛函、计算区域与目标数据。

有限组网格上误差下降是数值证据，不是收敛定理。即使积分范数下的误差下降，边界层或特征跳跃仍可能阻止最大范数下的收敛。

2. 适定性与伴随一致性不是同一件事

出现差异提供了诊断机会，但差异本身不能证明问题不适定。应先明确状态空间与边界迹空间、允许的数据、目标泛函以及范数。Hadamard 意义下的适定性要求解存在、唯一且连续依赖于数据。正确推导的连续伴随可以是适定的，而离散边界闭合却不一致；一个边界数据与目标泛函不匹配的适定方程，仍然是错误的伴随。约束乘子、有限正则性和参考解误差也会造成表观差异。

线性化、零空间与稳定性

把原始边界条件的齐次线性化约束纳入算子 D:X→Y 的定义域 X。如果该算子是适当空间之间的有界同构，则其 Banach 伴随也是相应对偶空间之间的有界同构。这给出一种充分的局部分析框架，并不是写出形式微分表达式就能得到的结论。对于无界 PDE 算子，必须先明确其定义域及图范数，或者采用适当的弱形式。对于非线性原始问题，仅有存在唯一性还不能保证解映射可微；需要在所选解支上检查局部光滑性及线性化可逆性。

对于 D*λ=g，原始算子的零模态给出必要的兼容性条件：

Dv=0⟹g[v]=⟨λ,Dv⟩=0.Dv=0\quad\Longrightarrow\quad g[v]=\langle\lambda,Dv\rangle=0.

若 ker D* 含有非零元素，则伴随一旦有解就不唯一。仅有与原始零空间正交的条件，并不能构成一般的无穷维存在性定理：还需要考虑值域闭性和稳定性。对齐次伴随边界数据，所需估计具有以下形式：

∥λ∥Y∗≤C∥g∥X∗\|\lambda\|_{Y^*}\le C\|g\|_{X^*}

如果边界数据非齐次，还应加上相应的边界迹范数。每个网格尺度下逆算子有界也不够：在正确加权的离散范数下，稳定界必须与网格尺度无关。不考虑积分残差和控制体权重的原始欧氏条件数，本身不能作为连续问题的诊断结论。

一个可显式求解的对流例子

取 c>0，固定原始入口值，目标变分为 ∫₀¹g v dx+b v(1)。对原始线性化 c v' 使用 Green 恒等式，得到

−cλ′=g,cλ(1)=b,λ(x)=bc+1c∫x1g(s) ds.-c\lambda'=g,\qquad c\lambda(1)=b,\qquad \lambda(x)=\frac{b}{c}+\frac1c\int_x^1g(s)\,ds.
  • 缺少出口数据： 解可以加上任意常数，因此不唯一。
  • 额外照搬原始入口条件 λ(0)=0： 存在性要求 b+∫g=0。当 g=1,b=0 时，正确解是 (1−x)/c；额外入口条件使问题无解。
  • 失去一致稳定性： 有 ‖λ‖∞≤(|b|+‖g‖₁)/c。取 g=1,b=0 就达到 1/c 的放大倍数。每个固定的 c>0 都可以对应适定问题，但对于这类数据，不能得到在 c→0 时仍统一有效的界。速度为零时，原始算子退化。

在原二维物体算例中，法向指向流体计算域的外部，所以迎风物面是流体域的原始出流边界。一条已经携带 u=1 的特征线，不可能在这里同时满足零物理通量。首先失败的是所假设的光滑正值原始问题，而不只是某个已经建立的连续伴随的离散逼近。在假定的壁面状态 u=0 处，

δ(12u2β⋅n)=u(β⋅n)v=0\delta(\tfrac12u^2\beta\cdot n)=u(\beta\cdot n)v=0

对任意变分 v 都成立：通量约束丢失了一阶约束信息，特征速度也同时退化。把壁面条件照抄到形式伴随上，不能恢复有效的光滑解支。弱解／熵解表述需要另行分析边界迹与可微性。

对于特征边界对照，每条内部射线都会在有限路程内到达出流边界。边界数据几乎处处确定内部场；切线或角点引出的跳跃可以在允许非光滑解的空间中处理，本身不意味着不适定。特征边界附近的比值 b_u/(a·n) 需要兼容性分析：在这里的物面目标中，分子与分母具有可相消的法向因子，不能只看分母就断言伴随发散。

其余算例说明了什么

对流扩散。 正扩散系数提供椭圆主部，但这不是任意低阶项与 Robin 边界系数下的普遍可逆性证明。仍需检查齐次零空间，以及所用能量估计或最大值原理的假设。独立计算支持当前参数组，没有证明对所有参数都成立的定理。把目标所要求的壁面伴随值 1 改成 0，可能得到另一个适定问题，但会给出错误的目标灵敏度。在远场同时规定状态值和法向导数，一般会过约束。把被替换方程行的乘子当成壁面场值，则是另一类代数含义错误。

拟一维 Euler。 对所述正向亚声速分支，特征速度 u−c,u,u+c 解释了原始入口两个条件、出口一个条件，以及伴随的相反条件数。条件数目正确是必要条件，不是充分条件：特征传播与边界约束共同组成的边值算子还必须可逆。声速点处 B 奇异，当前使用 (Bᵀ)⁻¹ 的表示失效，需要喉部兼容性／正则性分析。这不意味着所有跨声速伴随都不存在。激波还需要考虑激波位置变分及相应内部条件。这些现象超出当前数值证据的范围，可参考 Giles 与 Pierce 的连续喷管伴随分析。强、弱边界处理对数值伴随的不同影响，见 Duivesteijn 等人的研究。

因此，教学顺序应当是：先明确连续原始问题及所选解支；推导伴随，包括其边界定义域；分析存在性、唯一性和稳定性；随后才检查对该问题的一致、稳定逼近。反例应明确保留其失败的前提，不能悄悄替换模型后宣布验证成功。

3. 非线性标量对流：只有形式伴随还不够

实际通量是非线性的：

R(u)=∇⋅(12u2β),β=(1,12),a=uβ.R(u)=\nabla\cdot\bigl(\tfrac12u^2\beta\bigr),\qquad \beta=(1,\tfrac12),\quad a=u\beta.

对状态变分 v=δu，有

Ruv=∇⋅(av),∫ΩλRuv=−∫Ω(a⋅∇λ)v+∫∂Ωλ(a⋅n)v.R_u v=\nabla\cdot(av),\qquad \int_\Omega\lambda R_uv =-\int_\Omega(a\cdot\nabla\lambda)v +\int_{\partial\Omega}\lambda(a\cdot n)v.

对于 J=∫Ω j(u) + ∫∂Ω b(u)，驻值条件在原始边界迹可以自由变化的部分给出

−a⋅∇λ=ju,bu−λ(a⋅n)=0-a\cdot\nabla\lambda=j_u,\qquad b_u-\lambda(a\cdot n)=0

在给定的入流边界迹上，v=0，无需再给伴随数据。因此，伴随在原始出流边界接收数据；离开特征边界点时，有 λ=b_u/(a·n)。

原闭合零通量物面并不是光滑对流问题的壁面

原二维页面直接令物面数值通量为零，与内侧状态无关。但所述 PDE 的光滑边界迹具有物理通量

12u2β⋅n.\tfrac12u^2\beta\cdot n.

固定向量 β 不可能沿闭合多边形处处相切。在所有 β·n≠0 的位置，零物理通量要求 u=0。这会在物面的原始出流部分额外规定零值。在正值、无源分支中，u 沿每条直线特征保持不变。从远场以 u=1 进入并最终到达迎风物面的特征，不可能在那里同时满足 u=0。在 u=0 处，特征速度退化，因此不能靠把边界条件除以 u 来修复推导。

所以，当前零通量数值闭合不能提供上述连续伴随比较所需的光滑正值经典边值问题。这并不证明任何弱解或测度值解表述都不可能存在；这些表述需要明确的熵／边界迹规范和相应灵敏度分析，而当前页面没有建立这些理论。有限维残差、转置和离散梯度仍然有明确的定义。

明确区分的可计算对照：特征边界

仅在新增对照中，对内、外边界都按特征方向处理：在 β·n<0 处规定 u=1，在 β·n>0 处采用内侧物理通量。区域、内部数值通量及其 ε=0.8 保持与原页面相同。精确原始解为 u=1。

保留类似阻力的目标泛函

J=∫Γw12u2(e⋅n) ds,e=β/∣β∣,J=\int_{\Gamma_w}\tfrac12u^2(e\cdot n)\,ds, \qquad e=\beta/|\beta|,

但在给定入流处，目标使用已给定的边界迹，而不是一个自由的内侧值。这种目标取值方式的改变属于对照的一部分，不会暗中应用到原算例。连续伴随为

−β⋅∇λ=0,λ=1/∣β∣ on body outflow,λ=0 on outer outflow.-\beta\cdot\nabla\lambda=0,\quad \lambda=1/|\beta|\text{ on body outflow},\quad \lambda=0\text{ on outer outflow}.

从任一内部点沿 +β 方向追踪射线，直到第一个边界交点：若碰到物面则取 1/|β|，若碰到外边界则取零。这是精确的特征线计算，不是离散转置求解。物面切线或角点引出的射线上存在跳跃。比较采用体积加权 L2 误差；格点范数排除边界节点。这里不宣称光滑意义下的最大范数收敛，也不以这个对照证明原零通量壁面的连续一致性。

1. Signs, measures and three distinct checks

Write the steady PDE as R(u,p)=0, the functional as J, and use

L=J−∫ΩλTR dΩ.\mathcal L=J-\int_\Omega\lambda^T R\,d\Omega.

The pages solve A_h^T ψ_h = −g_h. Our continuous multiplier has the opposite sign: λ_h=−ψ_h on conservation equations. Those residuals are integrated balances, so there is no additional division by control-volume measure. Rows replaced by algebraic boundary constraints carry constraint multipliers; their values are not point samples of the continuous field.

Three tests answer different questions:

  1. A transpose/dot test checks the implementation of A_h^T.
  2. Finite differences of the same discrete problem check dJ_h/dp.
  3. Comparing an independently solved continuous dual with a sequence of refined discrete duals tests consistency in a stated norm. It requires matching PDE, boundary conditions, functional, domain, and target data.

A decreasing error on finitely many meshes is numerical evidence, not a theorem of convergence. Boundary layers or characteristic jumps can prevent maximum-norm convergence even when an integral norm decreases.

2. Well-posedness is not the same as adjoint consistency

A discrepancy is a diagnostic opportunity, not by itself proof of ill-posedness. Specify the state and trace spaces, admissible data, functional, and norms first. Hadamard well-posedness requires existence, uniqueness and continuous dependence. A correctly derived continuous dual can be well posed while a discrete boundary closure is inconsistent; a well-posed equation with the wrong objective boundary data is simply the wrong dual. Constraint multipliers, limited regularity and finite reference error are other sources of apparent disagreement.

Linearization, kernels and stability

Include the homogeneous linearized primal boundary constraints in the domain X of the operator D:X→Y. If this is a bounded isomorphism between suitable spaces, its Banach adjoint is also a bounded isomorphism between the dual spaces. This is a sufficient local framework, not a conclusion obtained merely by writing a formal differential expression. An unbounded PDE operator must first be given a domain/graph norm or a suitable weak realization. For a nonlinear primal, existence and uniqueness alone do not guarantee a differentiable solution map; the local smoothness and invertibility hypotheses must be checked on the chosen branch.

For D*λ=g, a primal null mode implies the necessary compatibility condition

Dv=0⟹g[v]=⟨λ,Dv⟩=0.Dv=0\quad\Longrightarrow\quad g[v]=\langle\lambda,Dv\rangle=0.

A nonzero element of ker D* makes a solvable dual nonunique. Orthogonality to the primal kernel alone is not a general infinite-dimensional existence theorem: closed range and stability still matter. The required estimate has the form

∥λ∥Y∗≤C∥g∥X∗\|\lambda\|_{Y^*}\le C\|g\|_{X^*}

for homogeneous dual boundary data; inhomogeneous boundary data contribute their appropriate trace norm. A bounded inverse at every mesh size is not enough either: the stability bound must be uniform in the properly weighted discrete norms. Raw Euclidean condition numbers without accounting for integrated residuals and control-volume weights are not themselves a continuum diagnosis.

An explicit transport example

For c>0, fixed primal inflow and objective variation ∫₀¹g v dx+b v(1), the Green identity for the primal linearization c v' gives

−cλ′=g,cλ(1)=b,λ(x)=bc+1c∫x1g(s) ds.-c\lambda'=g,\qquad c\lambda(1)=b,\qquad \lambda(x)=\frac{b}{c}+\frac1c\int_x^1g(s)\,ds.
  • Missing outlet data: an arbitrary additive constant remains, so uniqueness fails.
  • An extra copied primal inlet datum λ(0)=0: existence requires b+∫g=0. With g=1,b=0, the correct solution is (1−x)/c; the extra inlet condition makes the problem unsolvable.
  • Loss of uniform stability: ‖λ‖∞≤(|b|+‖g‖₁)/c. Taking g=1,b=0 attains the 1/c amplification. Each fixed c>0 is well posed, but there is no bound uniform as c→0 for this data class. At zero speed the original operator degenerates.

In the original 2-D body example, normals point out of the fluid domain: the upwind body is therefore primal outflow. A characteristic already carrying u=1 cannot satisfy zero physical flux there. This is first a failure of the assumed smooth positive primal problem, not merely a poor discrete approximation to an otherwise established dual. At a putative wall state u=0,

δ(12u2β⋅n)=u(β⋅n)v=0\delta(\tfrac12u^2\beta\cdot n)=u(\beta\cdot n)v=0

for every variation v: the flux constraint loses its first-order information while the characteristic speed degenerates. Copying the wall condition onto a formal dual cannot restore a valid smooth solution branch. Weak/entropy formulations would need separate trace and differentiability analysis.

For the characteristic-boundary contrast, every interior ray reaches outflow in finite distance. Boundary data determine the field almost everywhere; tangency/corner jumps are compatible with a nonsmooth solution space and do not by themselves imply ill-posedness. The ratio b_u/(a·n) requires compatibility at characteristic boundaries: in this particular body objective its numerator and denominator contain a cancelling normal factor. One must not infer blow-up from the denominator alone.

What the other cases demonstrate

Advection–diffusion. Positive diffusion provides an elliptic principal part, not a universal invertibility proof for arbitrary lower-order and Robin coefficients. Homogeneous kernels and the assumptions of applicable energy or maximum-principle estimates still need attention. The independent solves support this parameter set; they do not prove a theorem for all parameters. Setting the wall dual to zero instead of the objective-required one can define a different well-posed problem, but yields the wrong functional sensitivity. Imposing both state and normal derivative at the far field is generally an overconstraint. Treating a replaced-row multiplier as a wall field sample is yet another, algebraic interpretation error.

Quasi-1-D Euler. The speeds u−c,u,u+c explain the two inlet/one outlet primal conditions and reversed dual counts for the stated positive subsonic branch. Counts are necessary, not sufficient: propagation and the boundary constraints together must yield an invertible boundary-value operator. At a sonic point B is singular, so the current representation using (Bᵀ)⁻¹ fails; throat compatibility/regularity analysis is required. This does not imply that all transonic adjoints fail to exist. Shocks require shock-position variations and internal conditions. These phenomena are outside the current numerical evidence; see the continuous nozzle analysis of Giles and Pierce. The distinct effects of strong/weak boundary treatment on numerical duals are discussed by Duivesteijn et al..

The teaching sequence is therefore: identify the continuous primal and chosen branch; derive the dual including its boundary domain; examine existence, uniqueness and stability; only then test consistent, stable approximation of that problem. A counterexample should retain its failed premise visibly, rather than silently substituting another model and declaring success.

3. Nonlinear scalar transport: a formal adjoint is not enough

The actual flux is nonlinear:

R(u)=∇⋅(12u2β),β=(1,12),a=uβ.R(u)=\nabla\cdot\bigl(\tfrac12u^2\beta\bigr),\qquad \beta=(1,\tfrac12),\quad a=u\beta.

For a state variation v=δu,

Ruv=∇⋅(av),∫ΩλRuv=−∫Ω(a⋅∇λ)v+∫∂Ωλ(a⋅n)v.R_u v=\nabla\cdot(av),\qquad \int_\Omega\lambda R_uv =-\int_\Omega(a\cdot\nabla\lambda)v +\int_{\partial\Omega}\lambda(a\cdot n)v.

For J=∫Ω j(u) + ∫∂Ω b(u), stationarity gives

−a⋅∇λ=ju,bu−λ(a⋅n)=0-a\cdot\nabla\lambda=j_u,\qquad b_u-\lambda(a\cdot n)=0

on portions where the primal trace is free. On a prescribed inflow trace v=0, no adjoint datum is prescribed. Thus the adjoint receives its data at primal outflow, with λ=b_u/(a·n), away from characteristic points.

The original closed zero-flux body is not a smooth transport wall

The original two-dimensional pages set the numerical body flux to zero independently of the interior state. But a smooth trace of the stated PDE has physical flux

12u2β⋅n.\tfrac12u^2\beta\cdot n.

The fixed vector β is not tangent to the closed polygon. Wherever β·n≠0, zero physical flux requires u=0. This would impose an additional zero value at body outflow. In the positive, source-free branch, u is constant along each straight characteristic. A characteristic entering from the far field with u=1 and ending on the upwind side of the body cannot also have u=0 there. At u=0 the characteristic speed degenerates, so one cannot repair the derivation by dividing the boundary condition by u.

Consequently the present zero-flux numerical closure does not provide the smooth, positive classical boundary-value problem needed for the above continuous-dual comparison. This is not a proof that no weak or measure-valued formulation could ever be defined. Such a formulation would require an entropy/boundary-trace specification and an appropriate sensitivity analysis, absent from these pages. The finite-dimensional residual, transpose, and discrete gradients remain well defined.

A clearly separated, computable characteristic-boundary contrast

For the new comparison only, treat both outer and inner boundaries by characteristics: prescribe u=1 where β·n<0, and use the physical interior flux where β·n>0. The domain, interior numerical flux and its ε=0.8 remain the pages' own. The exact primal is u=1.

Keep the drag-like functional

J=∫Γw12u2(e⋅n) ds,e=β/∣β∣,J=\int_{\Gamma_w}\tfrac12u^2(e\cdot n)\,ds, \qquad e=\beta/|\beta|,

but at prescribed inflow use the prescribed trace in the functional, not a free interior value. This readout change is part of the contrast and is not silently applied to the original example. The continuous dual is

−β⋅∇λ=0,λ=1/∣β∣ on body outflow,λ=0 on outer outflow.-\beta\cdot\nabla\lambda=0,\quad \lambda=1/|\beta|\text{ on body outflow},\quad \lambda=0\text{ on outer outflow}.

At an interior point, follow the ray in direction +β to its first boundary intersection. The value is 1/|β| if that intersection is the body, and zero otherwise. This is an exact characteristic calculation, not a transpose solve. It has jumps along rays from body tangencies/corners. The comparison uses volume-weighted L2 error; boundary nodes are excluded from the node-centred norm. No smooth maximum-norm convergence is claimed. This contrast does not validate continuous consistency of the original zero-flux wall.

A.2 从方程到可运行参考实现

A.2 From equations to a runnable reference

读取边界线段 → 沿 +β 发射射线 → 选最近正向交点 → 物面取 1/|β|、远场取 0 → 体积加权比较

Read boundary segments → trace along +β → select first forward hit → body: 1/|β|, outer: 0 → volume-weighted comparison

下方代码可以完整复制到本地文件运行。它独立计算连续参考，不调用本页有限体积 Jacobian 的转置。二维代码内嵌两次细化的多边形网格；这里输出参考场，后面的多网格交互保留已计算的加密结果。

Copy the complete code below into a local file and run it. It computes the continuous reference independently of the page’s finite-volume Jacobian transpose. The 2-D scripts include the polygonal mesh refined twice; they output reference fields, while the refinement viewer below retains the precomputed multi-grid comparisons.

python3 -m pip install numpy scipy
python3 reference_transport.py

:"far"}}')
beta=np.array([1.,.5]);X=np.array(mesh['X']);segments=[]
for key,bc in mesh['bnd'].items():
 a,b=np.array(key.split('-'),int)-1
 segments.append((X[a],X[b],bc))
def cross(a,b): return a[0]*b[1]-a[1]*b[0]
def ray(p):
 hits=[]
 for a,b,bc in segments:
  d=b-a;den=cross(beta,d)
  if abs(den)<1e-14: continue
  t=cross(a-p,d)/den;z=cross(a-p,beta)/den
  if t>1e-9 and -1e-9<=z<=1+1e-9: hits.append((t,bc))
 if not hits: raise ValueError('No forward boundary intersection')
 return 1/np.linalg.norm(beta) if min(hits)[1]=='wall' else 0.
if __name__ == '__main__':
 points=np.array([X[np.array(c)-1].mean(axis=0) for c in mesh['C2N']])
 lam=np.array([ray(p) for p in points])
 np.savetxt('continuous_transport.csv',np.column_stack([points,lam]),delimiter=',',header='x,y,lambda')
 print('Characteristic-boundary contrast only:',len(lam),'samples; range',lam.min(),lam.max())

连续伴随与伴随一致性

Continuous adjoints and adjoint consistency

点积测试查转置，差分与复数步长查同一离散目标的梯度；它们都不能证明离散伴随逼近了连续伴随。本节先推导连续问题，再用独立参考解与网格加密比较。

A dot test checks the transpose; finite differences and the complex step check the gradient of the same discrete objective. None proves approximation of the continuous dual. Here we derive the continuous problem first, then compare with an independent reference under refinement.

Laug=J−∫ΩλTRdΩ,λh=−ψh

本页用 AhTψh=−gh（拟一维记 Jacobian 为 Jh），因此连续源项敏感度的符号是 λh=−ψh。守恒残差已做控制体积分，不再除以体积。

The pages use AhTψh=−gh (the quasi-1-D Jacobian is Jh), hence the source-sensitivity sign λh=−ψh. Conservation residuals are already integrated: do not divide by volume.

先做分部积分

First integrate by parts

Ruv=∇·(uβv),a=uβ
∫ΩλRuv=−∫Ω(a·∇λ)v+∫∂Ωλ(a·n)v

若 J=∫Ωj(u)+∫∂Ωb(u)，域内得到下式。原始入流的状态固定，v=0，不在那里给伴随条件；原始出流的 v 自由，由边界项给伴随条件。

For J=∫Ωj(u)+∫∂Ωb(u) the volume equation is below. At primal inflow the state is prescribed, v=0, and no dual datum is imposed there. At primal outflow v is free, so the boundary term supplies the dual datum.

−a·∇λ=ju,λ=bua·non primal outflow

原零通量内壁：连续问题的兼容性限制

The original zero-flux body: a compatibility obstruction

本页的壁面数值通量直接为零，与内侧状态无关。但原 PDE 的物理通量是 12u2β·n；固定的 β=(1,0.5) 不可能沿闭合物面处处相切。β·n≠0 处零物理通量要求 u=0。对从远场 u=1 进入、最后撞到迎风面的特征线，这与沿特征保持 u=1 矛盾；u=0 还使特征速度退化。

The original numerical wall flux is zero independently of the interior state. The PDE physical flux is 12u2β·n, but the fixed β=(1,0.5) cannot be tangent everywhere to a closed body. Where β·n≠0, zero physical flux requires u=0. A characteristic entering from the far field at u=1 and ending on the upwind body cannot satisfy that: its state stays one. At u=0 the characteristic speed also degenerates.

因此不能宣称原零通量算例具有这里所需的光滑、正值连续伴随参考。这不否定已有离散梯度，也不是排除所有弱解理论；它说明必须先另行定义弱解、边界迹及其灵敏度，不能把二维标量的“壁面”直接当作 Euler 滑移壁面。

The original zero-flux example therefore does not supply the smooth positive continuous reference required here. Its discrete gradients remain valid. This does not exclude every weak-solution theory; such a theory would need its own boundary traces and sensitivities. A scalar “wall” cannot simply be treated as an Euler slip wall.

可计算的对照：特征边界与解析连续伴随

A computable contrast: characteristic boundaries and an exact dual

仅在本节对照中，把内、外边界都改为：入流给 u=1，出流外推。目标仍是壁面 12u2(e·n) 的积分，但入流段使用已给定的边界迹，不对内侧未知量求导。原页面第 1–14 节的算例不变。此时精确原始解 u=1，e=β/|β|，域内 −β·∇λ=0。

For this contrast only, prescribe u=1 at inflow on both boundaries and extrapolate at outflow. The objective is still the wall integral of 12u2(e·n), but uses the prescribed trace on inflow rather than differentiating an interior unknown there. Sections 1–14 are unchanged. Now the exact primal is u=1, e=β/|β|, and −β·∇λ=0 inside.

λ=1|β|on body outflow,λ=0on outer outflow

从任一内点沿 +β 追踪射线，到第一个边界交点：遇到物面取 1/|β|，遇到远场取 0。这就是连续伴随的独立计算，不解离散转置。它沿物面切线／角点发出的特征有跳跃；所以检查体积加权 L2，不要求最大范数收敛。

Trace a ray from an interior point along +β to its first boundary intersection: assign 1/|β| at the body, zero at the outer boundary. This independently computes the continuous dual without a discrete transpose. Jumps issue from body tangencies/corners; use volume-weighted L2 and do not demand maximum-norm convergence.

层 / LevelDOFL2max
0242.497e-015.816e-01
1802.237e-015.588e-01
22881.935e-015.270e-01
310881.630e-015.723e-01

表中是特征边界对照，不是原零通量边界的验证。格点范数排除边界节点；离散耗散把连续伴随的跳跃抹宽，L2 误差下降较慢。下图可切换网格、连续场、离散场与差值。

These are results for the characteristic-boundary contrast, not validation of the original zero-flux boundary. The node norm excludes boundary nodes. Numerical dissipation broadens the dual jumps, so L2 decreases slowly. The viewer switches grid, continuous field, discrete field and difference.

不一致时先检查什么：存在、唯一与稳定

What to check when results disagree: existence, uniqueness and stability

伴随不一致与伴随问题不适定不是同一件事。适定性要求在明确的函数空间、边界迹与数据范数下：解存在、唯一，并连续依赖于数据。比较之前先固定同一个原始问题、目标泛函、边界条件和乘子含义；边界层、有限参考误差、错误的目标边界项，都可能造成差异，不能仅凭一张误差图判定不适定。

Adjoint inconsistency and an ill-posed adjoint problem are different diagnoses. Well-posedness requires existence, uniqueness and continuous dependence on data in specified function spaces, trace spaces and norms. First match the primal problem, functional, boundary conditions and multiplier interpretation. Boundary layers, finite reference error, an incorrect objective boundary term can all cause discrepancies; an error plot alone cannot diagnose ill-posedness.

在线性化状态及边界约束都已确定后，记原始线性算子为 D，伴随方程为 D*λ=g。若 D 是适当空间之间的有界同构，正确配对的对偶问题也有有界逆。若存在非零零模态 v，则可解性至少要求 g[v]=0；伴随自身有非零齐次解时，解就不唯一。无穷维情形还必须检查值域闭性／稳定估计，不能只数边界条件。

After fixing the linearized state and boundary constraints, denote the primal operator by D and the dual equation by D*λ=g. If D is a bounded isomorphism between suitable spaces, its correctly paired dual also has a bounded inverse. A nonzero primal null mode v requires at least g[v]=0 for solvability; a nonzero homogeneous dual mode makes the dual nonunique. In infinite dimensions one must also check closed range/stability estimates, not merely count boundary conditions.

Dv=0⇒g[v]=⟨λ,Dv⟩=0

非线性原始解存在唯一，也不自动保证其导数存在：还需要所选解支的局部可微性和线性化可逆性。下面讨论的都是已说明的光滑解支；不把有限网格上能解出的转置系统当作连续理论的替代。

Even existence and uniqueness of a nonlinear primal do not automatically ensure differentiability: local smoothness of the chosen solution branch and invertibility of its linearization are additional requirements. The discussion concerns the stated smooth branch; a solvable finite-grid transpose system is not a substitute for continuous analysis.

一条特征线就能看出：少条件、多条件与失稳

One characteristic exposes missing data, excess data and instability

取区间 0<x<1、常数速度 c>0，原始入口固定，目标含体积分及出口项 bu(1)。分部积分给出下式，唯一解从原始出口向上游积分：

On 0<x<1, take constant speed c>0, fixed primal inflow and an objective with a volume term and outlet term bu(1). Integration by parts gives the following unique solution, integrated upstream from primal outflow:

−cλ′=g,cλ(1)=b,λ(x)=bc+1c∫x1g(s)ds

少条件：不规定出口伴随值时可加任意常数，解不唯一。多条件：若还照搬原始入口而规定 λ(0)=0，则必须满足 b+∫01gdx=0；例如 g=1,b=0 时正确解是 (1−x)/c，额外入口条件使问题无解。失去一致稳定性：上述数据到解的放大含 1/c，因此不能在 c→0 时声称有与 c 无关的稳定界。每个固定 c>0 仍然可以适定。

Missing data: without the outlet dual value, an arbitrary additive constant remains, so the solution is nonunique. Excess data: also copying the primal inflow condition as λ(0)=0 requires b+∫01gdx=0. For g=1,b=0, the correct solution is (1−x)/c and the extra inlet condition makes it impossible. Loss of uniform stability: data amplification contains 1/c, so no bound independent of c is justified as c→0. Each fixed c>0 can still define a well-posed problem.

把诊断用到原零通量内壁

Apply the diagnosis to the original zero-flux body

法向始终取计算域的外法向，内边界的法向指向物体。因此迎风物面是流体域的原始出流：特征已从远场携带 u=1 到达这里，再要求零物理通量就是不相容的额外限制。这里首先缺少的是原始光滑正值解，故没有合法的该分支线性化状态；不能跳过这一步，只给形式伴随补几个边界值。

The normal always points out of the fluid domain, into the body on its inner boundary. The upwind body is therefore primal outflow from the fluid: a characteristic already carries u=1 from the far field, and requiring zero physical flux adds an incompatible restriction. The first obstruction is the absence of the stated smooth positive primal, hence of a valid linearization about that branch; appending boundary values to a formal dual cannot repair this.

δ(12u2β·n)=u(β·n)v

若退到壁面 u=0，上式对任意 v 都为零：一阶线性化丢失了原非线性通量条件的约束信息，特征速度也同时退化。这个退化不能用“把零通量条件照抄给伴随”来修复。要讨论允许停滞、间断或弱解的新问题，必须另建解空间、熵／边界迹条件及可微性理论。

At a wall state u=0, this first variation vanishes for every v: linearization loses information contained in the nonlinear flux constraint while the characteristic speed degenerates. Copying a zero-flux condition onto the adjoint does not repair it. A new problem allowing stagnation, discontinuities or weak solutions needs its own solution space, entropy/boundary traces and differentiability theory.

对于本节相容的特征边界对照，每条内部特征沿 +β 都能在有限路程内到达出流边界，因此边界数据确定内部场（除去零测集上的取值约定）。切线或角点发出的跳跃不等于不适定；应在允许跳跃的空间中讨论。一般边界公式中的 bu/(a·n) 在特征边界附近需要兼容性分析，本对照的物面分子与分母同时含法向因子并相消，不能仅看分母趋零就宣称伴随发散。

For the compatible contrast, every interior characteristic followed along +β reaches outflow in finite distance, determining the interior field up to values on sets of measure zero. Jumps from tangencies or corners do not imply ill-posedness; use a space allowing them. The general ratio bu/(a·n) requires compatibility analysis near characteristic boundaries. In this contrast its body numerator and denominator share a cancelling normal factor, so a vanishing denominator alone does not establish adjoint blow-up.

矩阵能求逆为什么还不够

Why an invertible matrix is not enough

即使每个有限网格上的 AhT 都可逆，也不保证在网格相关的正确加权范数中，其逆有与 h 无关的界。人工耗散或边界闭合可能让每个有限系统可解，却不能给出目标连续问题的稳定极限。要判断一致性，应先建立连续问题，再检查残差与目标的逼近、边界乘子的对应关系以及离散稳定性；若这些前提不成立，就把它保留为反例并准确指出失败环节。

Even if every finite-grid AhT is invertible, its inverse need not be bounded independently of h in the appropriate mesh-weighted norms. Artificial dissipation or boundary closure may make every finite system solvable without providing a stable limit for the intended continuous problem. Establish the continuous problem first, then check residual/functional approximation, boundary-multiplier interpretation and discrete stability. If a premise fails, retain the example and identify the failed premise explicitly.

Appendix B: continuous adjoint of the added smooth model

令 F=u²β/2，J=∫Γinner u²(e·n)/2 ds，采用与正文一致的 ℒ=J+∫Ω ψ∇·F dΩ。固定几何时 δF=uβδu。对残差变分积分一次，得到内部方程和边界项。

Let F=u²β/2 and J=∫Γinner u²(e·n)/2 ds. Use ℒ=J+∫Ω ψ∇·F dΩ, matching the discrete sign convention. For fixed geometry, δF=uβδu. Integrating by parts gives the volume equation and boundary term.

δL=−∫Ωuβ⋅∇ψ δu dΩ+∫∂Ω[ψuβ⋅n+χinnerue⋅n]δu ds.\delta\mathcal L=-\int_\Omega u\boldsymbol\beta\cdot\nabla\psi\,\delta u\,d\Omega+\int_{\partial\Omega}\left[\psi u\boldsymbol\beta\cdot n+\chi_{inner}u\boldsymbol e\cdot n\right]\delta u\,ds.
β⋅∇ψ=0,ψ∣Γ+={−1/∥β∥,Γ+∩Γinner,0,Γ+∩Γouter.\boldsymbol\beta\cdot\nabla\psi=0,\qquad \psi|_{\Gamma_+}=\begin{cases}-1/\|\beta\|,&\Gamma_+\cap\Gamma_{inner},\\0,&\Gamma_+\cap\Gamma_{outer}.\end{cases}

固定入流数据时 δu=0，所以不再给原始入流边界指定额外伴随值。原始出流处 δu 自由，必须消去方括号中的系数。即使 β·n 在某点接近零，内边界 e 与 β 平行使比值保持 −1/|β|；恰好相切的射线及角点仍需按几乎处处的输运解理解。

For fixed inflow data δu=0, so no additional adjoint value is prescribed on primal inflow. At primal outflow δu is free, requiring the bracketed coefficient to vanish. Because e is parallel to β, the inner-boundary ratio stays −1/|β| near grazing; exactly tangent rays and corners still require an almost-everywhere transport interpretation.

从每个内部点沿 +β 追踪，首次遇到内边界则 ψ=−1/|β|，首次遇到外边界则 ψ=0。这是独立几何射线计算，不调用离散矩阵。两类射线的分界可能产生伴随跳变，它由终端目标数据造成，不是原始流场激波。若改用 ℒ=J−∫λ∇·F，则 λ=−ψ。

Trace +β from each interior point. Set ψ=−1/|β| if the first intersection is the inner boundary and zero if it is outer. This independent geometric ray calculation does not call a discrete matrix. Interfaces between the two ray families can have adjoint jumps caused by terminal objective data, not primal shocks. Under ℒ=J−∫λ∇·F, λ=−ψ.

for point x in fluid domain:
    hits = positive_ray_intersections(x, beta, all_boundary_edges)
    first = hit_with_smallest_positive_distance(hits)
    psi_ref[x] = -1/norm(beta) if first.is_inner else 0

改变入流均值 a 时，入流边界剩余项为 ∫Γ− u(ψβ·n+χinner e·n)δa ds。改变几何时还必须包含移动边界和 g 的位置导数，不能只保留法向项。在本例全局解析场下，J 对所有有效边界形变及 a 恒为零，可由孔洞内散度定理独立证明；因此完整连续总导数也为零。粗网格离散梯度不必为零，它应通过重算差分与复数残差来检验。

Changing a leaves the inflow term ∫Γ− u(ψβ·n+χinner e·n)δa ds. Geometry variations additionally require moving-boundary and position-dependent g terms, not merely normal derivatives. For this global analytic field, J is identically zero for valid boundary shapes and all a, independently by the divergence theorem inside the hole. Its complete continuous total derivatives are zero. Coarse discrete gradients need not vanish and are checked by reconverged differences and complex residuals.

/* Continuous reference from boundary intersections alone; no discrete Jacobian. */
(function(root){function reference(mesh,p,node=-1){const beta=[1,.5],hits=[];for(const cell of mesh.C2N)for(let j=0;j<cell.length;j++){const ia=cell[j],ib=cell[(j+1)%cell.length],key=[Math.min(ia,ib),Math.max(ia,ib)].join('-'),bc=mesh.bnd[key];if(!bc)continue;const A=mesh.X[ia-1],B=mesh.X[ib-1],d=[B[0]-A[0],B[1]-A[1]],q=[A[0]-p[0],A[1]-p[1]],vn=d[1]-.5*d[0];if(Math.abs(vn)<1e-12)continue;const t=(q[0]*d[1]-q[1]*d[0])/vn,z=(q[0]*beta[1]-q[1]*beta[0])/vn;if(node>=0&&(ia-1===node||ib-1===node)&&vn>0)hits.push({t:0,bc,hit:p.slice()});else if(t>1e-9&&z>=-1e-10&&z<=1+1e-10)hits.push({t,bc,hit:[p[0]+t,p[1]+.5*t]});}if(!hits.length)throw Error('No characteristic terminal intersection');hits.sort((a,b)=>a.t-b.t);return {...hits[0],psi:hits[0].bc==='wall'?-1/Math.sqrt(1.25):0};}if(typeof module!=='undefined')module.exports=reference;else root.TransportRay=reference;})(typeof window!=='undefined'?window:globalThis);
